      "title": "从 RAG 到 Grep 到 Progressive Disclosure：agent 自建上下文的三个进化阶段",
      "content": "Claude Code 搜索/上下文能力三阶段演化：\n- **Phase 1 - RAG**：系统用向量数据库检索上下文喂给 Claude。问题：需索引和 setup，跨环境脆弱，Claude 被动接收而非主动发现\n- **Phase 2 - Grep Tool**：给 Claude 搜索工具让它自己找文件。关键转变：从\"喂上下文\"到\"给找上下文的工具\"。模型越聪明越擅长自己构建上下文\n- **Phase 3 - Progressive Disclosure via Skills**：skill 文件可引用其他文件，Claude 递归读取。能跨多层文件做嵌套搜索找到精确上下文\n\n核心判断：模型越聪明，越应该给它找上下文的工具而不是替它找。这是\"渐进式披露\"原则在 tool surface 层的完整产品化落地。",

      "id": "crystal_cf7feceb5517",
      "title": "dsh-agent-team Member 工具面的绕过面与封闭路径：preset 白名单只拦继承工具，own-scope 注册可在 agent/created 后注入",
      "content": "[[dsh-agent-team]] 的「Member 工具面可被第三方插件绕过」是一次只读调查（`member-tool-surface-control`）的结论：**preset 白名单只约束「继承来的工具」，管不住「在 Member 自己 scope 上注册的工具」**——这是架构事实，不是配置失误。\n\n## 一、绕过机制（为什么 restrict 拦不住）\n- 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team` 的 `apply()` 遍历 `ctx.agents.list()` 并监听 `agent/created`，对满足 `ctx.agentTeams.tryMembership` 的成员调用 `install(agent, ...)`，**在该 Member 自身 scope 上**注册 Team 工具与提示词。\n- 时序决定一切：`agent/created` 在 Member 的 `setup()` 完成、registry 已发布**之后**才触发。因此这些工具天然出现在 preset 装载与 `restrict()` **之后**。\n- `tools` 的 `view(scope)` 只对各层 `admits` 过滤**继承层**（global 与祖先层）工具；scope 自身注册的工具在最后无条件加入 `visible`，并可遮蔽同名继承工具。`restrict()` 还显式拒绝命名本 scope 的工具。\n- 结论：`tools.restrict` 的 allow-list 语义是「过滤继承来的全局工具」，对 own-scope 注册无私有权。现有 `validateMemberPreset` 只做**正向检查**（团队工具在不在），不做**反向检查**（有没有多出来的工具），所以污染静默通过。\n\n## 二、连带发现的第二个洞：私有记忆索引\nTeam 成员的私有记忆索引按**完整替换**方式注入上下文——即成员上下文的这一段落不叠加，而是整体覆盖，进一步说明「Member scope 是一个可被多方写入且后写者全胜的平面」。\n\n## 三、工具面其实真的是模型可见面（假设被否证）\n「`tools` 字段仅是提示词文本」的假设不成立：`PromptAssembly.tools` 就是 LLM request 的 `tools` 数组。链路为 `ToolRuntime` 构造时经 `ctx.systemPrompt.tools(ctx => this.wireSchemas(ctx.scope))` 注册唯一 provider → `wireSchemas` 取自 `view(scope).visible` → `system-prompt.assemble()` 经 waterfall 产出 → `agent-loop` 的 `buildRequest` 把 tools 写进 `canonicalHeader` 并落 `request/header` 事件（schema 增删会生成 tool-addition/removal 开发者消息）。因此 own-scope 注入即等于「模型真的看得见并能调」。\n\n## 四、可封闭工具面的两个公开 seam（无需私有字段猴子补丁）\n1. **模型请求层**：scoped 的 `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall，listener 重写 `assembly.tools` 即改变真正发出的 tools；\n2. **执行层**：经 `agent.ctx` 注册的 `tools.guard()`（天然 per-agent），语义是**执行前单调否决**、按 scope 链遍历、拒绝呈现为 `UNKNOWN_TOOL`——它压的是「能不能跑」，不改「看得见什么」。\n- 不变式：改了 schema 必须同步改提示词。`sections` 无法删除他人注册的 section，但 waterfall 可把 `assembly.sections[].text` 置空；否则会留下「schema 已屏蔽、提示词仍在教模型调用」的不一致。\n- 已排除的路径：`agent/request` 的 per-agent LLM middleware 虽 scoped，但返回类型 `LlmCallConfig` 不含 `tools`，触及不到 schema 面；`llm/stream` 签名为 `this: LlmRuntime`、非 Scoped，属进程级（该点只读声明未读 dispatch，调查中标注为未验证）。另 `systemPrompt.add` 是同层重名报错、跨层遮蔽，且无枚举/按名移除 API——这也是「只能靠 assembly 改写」的建筑原因。\n\n## 五、方案取向\n**不要改 `restrict` 的语义**（会破坏既有 allow-list 合同与所有既有 preset）。正确做法是**新增一个独立的可见性过滤 seam**，并补齐生命周期与日志：过滤发生在 own-scope 注册之后、schema 生成之前，且要对「被屏蔽了什么」留下可审计记录，否则沉默的过滤会变成新的排障黑洞。\n\n## 六、事实边界\n- 威胁成立的前提是「有插件在 `agent/created` 时向 Member scope 注册工具」；这是机制推演 + 代码路径证据，**本地未复现实际污染**。\n- 调查纪律：这一轮明确只交事实与代码证据（含文件行号），不夹带修复建议；「未验证」必须显式标注，不能与已验证结论混排。\n",

      "title": "Prompt Caching 优先的 Agent 工程设计原则",
      "content": "# Prompt Caching 优先的 Agent 工程设计原则\n\n从 Claude Code 的架构实践中提炼的 Agent 工程设计原则，以 prompt caching 为核心约束。\n\n## Prompt Cache 优先的设计\n\nPrompt caching 基于前缀匹配（prefix match），任何前缀层改变会 invalidate 之后所有缓存。**布局顺序决定一切**：静态内容优先，动态内容靠后。\n\n**标准四层结构**：① Static system prompt & Tools（全局缓存）→ ② Claude.MD（项目级）→ ③ Session context（会话级）→ ④ Conversation messages\n\n**常见破缓存原因**：在 static prompt 放详细时间戳、非确定性排列 tool 顺序、改 tool 参数。\n\n## 核心设计模式\n\n### 1. 用 Message 代替 System Prompt 更新\n更新时间/状态等动态信息时，通过 `<system-reminder>` tag 在下一轮 user message 或 tool result 中传递，不修改 system prompt。\n\n### 2. 模型切换用 subagent handoff，不直接切\nPrompt cache 是模型独有的。100k tokens 后切到小模型反而更贵（重建整个缓存）。正确做法：主模型（Opus）把任务整理成 handoff message 传给子模型（Haiku），子模型从干净上下文开始。[[Claude Code|Claude Code's]] Explore agents 即此模式。\n\n### 3. Plan Mode 作为 tool，不换工具集\n直观方案是切换工具集（只留只读），但会 invalidate 整个对话缓存。实际方案——所有工具始终在请求中，加 EnterPlanMode 和 ExitPlanMode 作为 tool。额外收益：模型可自主调用——当它发现问题复杂时自己进入 plan mode，全程不破缓存。\n\n### 4. Task-Specific Subagent 代替 Tool 膨胀\nClaude Code 约 20 个工具，加新工具门槛高。当需要新能力时（如回答「如何使用 Claude Code」），构建 subagent 而非加工具。这是 progressive disclosure 的另一种实现——在 action space 不变前提下扩展能力范围。\n\n### 5. Defer Load 代替 Remove\n大量 MCP tools 时，发 lightweight stub（名称 + defer_loading:true），模型通过 ToolSearch 按需发现完整 schema，缓存前缀始终稳定。\n\n### 6. 安全 Compaction\n复用父会话完全相同的 system prompt/tools/context，追加父会话 messages + compaction prompt 作为最后一条 user message。从 API 视角「几乎和上一次请求一样」，命中缓存前缀。\n\n### 7. AskUserQuestion 的三次迭代教训\n独立工具优于参数复用（职责清晰），结构化输出优于格式约定（稳定可靠）。最终标准不是设计多优雅，而是模型是否愿意且正确地调用它。\n\n### 8. Agent 自建上下文的三个进化阶段\n- **Phase 1 - RAG**：系统用向量数据库检索上下文喂给 agent。问题：需索引和 setup，跨环境脆弱\n- **Phase 2 - Grep Tool**：给 agent 搜索工具让它自己找文件。关键转变：从「喂上下文」到「给找上下文的工具」\n- **Phase 3 - Progressive Disclosure**：skill 文件可引用其他文件，agent 递归读取。模型越聪明，越应该给它找上下文的工具而不是替它找",

      "title": "Xi context assembly 完整管线：系统提示 + 7 层 inject 组装",
      "content": "Xi 每轮 turn 启动时由 context.ts 组装 LLM 上下文，assembleXiContext 产出 messages 数组 + hot raw messages → session.prompt(inject) 追加当前 inject。完整组装顺序：\n\n1. 系统提示（Xi session 创建时固定）：SYSTEM.md（世界法则，人工维护，~1500 tokens）→ SOUL.md（核心身份，proposal+人工）→ INSTRUCTIONS.md（chat）或 BACKGROUND.md（background，promotion 演化）→ MEMORY.md（长期记忆，consolidation 每天重写）\n\n2. [inject: current_now_from_now_md]：读 memory/now.md，截断 2200 字符。Xi 看到的是自己留的短期思绪线索，非任务列表。\n\n3. [inject: daily_memory]：读今天和昨天的 memory/daily/<day>.md，优先取 ## summary 段。昨天标注\"昨天发生过的事\"，今天标注\"今天发生过的事\"。\n\n4. [recent_context]：从 xi.jsonl 解析历史消息分两类——covered lines（已 steward 消费，保留最后 12 行桥接）和 active lines（当前活跃段，保留最后 80 行）。工具调用归组到同一 Xi turn。连续多气泡渲染为\"曦：1)... 2)...\"。\n\n5. [inject: recalled_context]（仅 XI_RECALL_INJECT=chat 时）：chat/queued_replay/steer 时通过 recall SQLite FTS5 查询，要求 >=2 hits 跨 >=2 天、非全 draft、可见上下文去重后才注入。位置在 recent_context 后、user_event 前。寒暄查询被跳过。\n\n6. 热 raw 窗口：上一个 turn 尾部 raw AgentMessages 写入 state/runtime/hot-raw-messages.json（5 分钟窗口），下一个 turn 直接拼接不过 xi.jsonl 重建。写入时过滤 no_reply 和纯上下文 inject。after_chat 用更长窗口。\n\n7. [inject: user_event]（chat）或 [inject: background_event]（background 带 orientation narrative）或 [inject: after_chat]（离上次说话时间 + 自然提示）：由 turn-runner.ts 通过 session.prompt() 追加。\n\n逻辑日边界 03:00 Asia/Shanghai，非日历日。after_chat 完成后合并旧 hot_raw + after_chat 有效 raw 写回，而非覆盖。",

1	# .scratch Work Rules
2	
3	This subtree holds cross-session work items: design snapshots, research, implementation tickets, prototypes, and acceptance evidence. It is not an implementation or API authority — current behavior is defined by `packages/` source and tests, and maintenance rules by [`../docs/AGENTS.md`](../docs/AGENTS.md). This file only governs how to work here.
4	
5	## Work-item structure
6	
7	Each `active/<work>/` is one directory with a short `README.md` as its single continuation entry, covering five items: status, last-checked date, current frontier (who is doing what and what is blocked), completion conditions, and the formal-doc exit.
8	
9	```
10	active/<work>/
11	├── README.md      # continuation entry (the five items above)
12	├── spec.md        # confirmed decision snapshot — written once discussion converges
13	├── issues/        # tracer-bullet implementation tickets, one file per ticket
14	│   ├── 01-<slug>.md
15	│   └── 02-<slug>.md
16	├── materials/     # research and external material (keep only what is worth re-reading)
17	└── validation/    # human-confirmed acceptance evidence (see the development doc)
18	```
19	
20	## Ticket discipline
21	
22	Each `issues/NN-<slug>.md` uses a fixed skeleton, numbered from `01` in dependency order (blockers first):
23	
24	```markdown
25	# NN — title
26	
27	**What to build:** the end-to-end behavior this ticket demonstrably delivers once done (user perspective, not a layered task list)
28	**Blocked by:** the tickets blocking it, or "None — can start immediately"
29	**Status:** pending | ready | in-progress | complete
30	
31	- [ ] acceptance criterion 1
32	- [ ] acceptance criterion 2
33	```
34	
35	- **Vertical slices**: each ticket cuts one narrow, complete path through every layer (schema → API → UI → tests), independently verifiable when done; no horizontal division of labor by layer.
36	- **Self-contained tickets**: each ticket can start in a new context without reading the whole work-item history. Avoid concrete file paths and code snippets (they go stale); exception: decision-dense fragments from prototypes (state machines, type shapes) may be inlined with their source noted.
37	- **Frontier workflow**: tickets whose blockers are all done form the frontier and are ready to start; a serial chain runs top to bottom. Tickets that are written but still carry unfinished blockers stay **pending**, so `ready` always means startable now.
38	- **Wide-refactor exception**: when one mechanical change's blast radius covers the whole repository, do not force it into a tracer bullet — order it as expand–contract: expand first (old and new coexist), migrate in batches, then contract (delete the old form).
39	
40	## Lifecycle
41	
42	- **Closing a work item**: close or delete unfinished tickets → move durable conclusions into the `../docs/` maintained documents → delete process material without provenance value → move into `archive/YYYY-MM/`.
43	- **Archive is history**: archived states and terminology only represent the working context of their time and never override current implementation; do not rewrite archives to match new code.
44	- **Transient artifacts**: logs, debug screenshots, and downloads go in `local/` or `artifacts/` (gitignored), never into active or archive.
45	
46	## Version control
47	
48	- **Active does not enter version history**: while a work item is open, its `active/<work>/` directory is gitignored working material. Force-add it (`git add -f`) only when a reviewer must see it.
49	- **Archive enters history on close**: when a work item closes, move it into `archive/YYYY-MM/` and amend that move into the commit(s) that deliver the work, so the archive records what actually shipped instead of sitting in a scratch-only commit at the tip.
50	
51	## Directory index
52	
53	See [README.md](README.md).
54

1	# SCOPE：工具结果、通知与 Agent context
2	
3	## 起因
4	
5	Attention 改造需要在多种结果中解释 follow/unfollow：
6	
7	- owner、accountable、Claim executor、Thread 作者自动建立 Attention；
8	- 显式 follow / unfollow；
9	- active Claim 导致的 unfollow 拒绝；
10	- Thread / Main stream 读取与通知中的当前状态；
11	- @ / reply 是一次直接通知，不等于持续关注。
12	
13	这些说明如果分别手写，会与现有工具结果、recovery hint、Host notification 和 persona 一样继续分散。Human 因此要求另开工作项，统一并审视整个 Agent-facing 工具与 context 呈现，而不只处理 Attention 文案。
14	
15	## 目标
16	
17	让 Agent 在合适的时刻获得足够且不过量的信息：
18	
19	1. 刚刚发生了什么。
20	2. 当前与下一步有关的状态是什么。
21	3. 为什么出现这个状态（仅当事实可确定）。
22	4. 下一步可以做什么，或被什么阻塞。
23	5. 哪里可以读取完整事实，而不是在通知里复制完整事实。
24	
25	统一的是**事实来源、语义和预算原则**，不是强迫所有出口显示相同文本。
26	
27	## 初步目标结构
28	
29	```text
30	ledger / runtime projection / operation result
31	  → 面向 Agent 的结构化状态与变化事实
32	  → 各出口的 renderer
33	     tool result：本次变化与必要状态
34	     error：拒绝原因与可执行恢复
35	     notification：唤醒原因与读取入口
36	     dynamic context：当前身份、参与和必要状态
37	     persona / core skill：稳定规则与按需参考
38	```
39	
40	结构化数据仍是 Host、Client、测试与恢复逻辑的权威。自然语言不成为第二份状态来源，Client 不解析提示文本来恢复事实。
41	
42	## 范围
43	
44	### 工具设计与结果
45	
46	审视七个 Team tools 的：
47	
48	- action 划分、参数 schema、默认值与 Workspace 推断；
49	- structured result 与 render 是否一致；
50	- 成功、无提交、typed rejection、抛错的结果差异；
51	- 当前状态、已读/未读、Task/Claim、refs、revision 和恢复指引；
52	- 相同概念是否在不同工具中使用不同名称或给出矛盾建议；
53	- 输出是否有界，省略后是否仍指出完整事实的读取入口。
54	
55	本工作项可以提出工具契约修正，但不能把「统一文案」当成拒绝修正糟糕工具设计的理由。
56	
57	### Agent 通知与错误
58	
59	审视：
60	
61	- Host 从 durable unread 派生的 direct / activity / ordinary / Main / reminder 通知；
62	- DM relay、Workspace participation、恢复和上下文换代相关通知；
63	- recovery-hints 与 tool-level rejection 的重复、冲突和缺失；
64	- 同一事实在通知、工具结果和后续读取中是否被无意义重复。
65	
66	### Prompt 与动态 context
67	
68	审视：
69	
70	- persona prefix 与 core skills 的稳定规则；
71	- Member identity、Project ownership、Workspace participation、private memory 和 time context；
72	- 通知与工具结果是否重复 persona 已常驻说明的规则；
73	- 动态状态是否被误写进稳定 prompt，或稳定教学是否在每次结果里重复；
74	- context 注入的更新、替换、持久化与重放是否仍由原有 authority 决定。
75	
76	## 非目标
77	
78	- 不建立要求所有工具共用一个巨型函数或统一字符串的抽象。
79	- 不让每次工具调用附带整套领域教学。
80	- 不把 notification 变成完整 Thread/Task 内容副本。
81	- 不用自然语言代替 structured fields，也不让渲染层产生 ledger authority。
82	- 不改变 Human Web Client 的视觉呈现，除非后续另有明确需求。
83	- 不一次重写所有工具；先盘点，再用窄的端到端用例验证机制。
84	- 不重复 `team-tools-model-eval` 的评测建设，也不改变 `attention-delivery-model` 已确认的领域决策。
85	
86	## 初步设计原则
87	
88	1. **事实共享，文本分型**：同一语义可复用，不同出口按用途和预算渲染。
89	2. **操作结果说变化，读取结果说状态**：原因只来自本次操作或可靠事实，不猜历史动机。
90	3. **稳定规则常驻，动态状态按需**：persona/core skill 与动态 context 分工明确。
91	4. **错误给恢复，不只给拒绝**：建议必须与当前状态和实际可执行动作一致。
92	5. **通知给入口，正文按需读**：维持有界、合并、可重派生的通知边界。
93	6. **重要信息优先于重复信息**：同一 turn / result 中避免 persona、notice、result 多次说同一件事。
94	7. **一次迁移到位**：机制确认后删除被替代的旧渲染和重复提示，不长期保留双路径。
95	
96	## 只读审查清单
97	
98	- [ ] 七个工具逐一对照 schema → execute → structured result → render → tests → maintained docs。
99	- [ ] 标出共享 helper、各工具私有 renderer 和 Host 私有 renderer 的真实边界。
100	- [ ] 对照 `recovery-hints`、工具拒绝和通知文本，找出同一状态的不同说法。
101	- [ ] 对照 persona、`team-domain-model`、member/time context，标出常驻与动态的重复。
102	- [ ] 统计典型结果的行数/字符量和正文预算，找出高价值状态被教学文本淹没的情况。
103	- [ ] 从模型评测材料提取可复现的证据，区分模型误用、schema 问题和结果指导不足。
104	- [ ] 选定 Attention 的最小端到端用例，再决定第二个用例；不预设所有状态都需要统一。
105	
106	## 待与 Human 拍板的问题
107	
108	### Q1. 统一的落点
109	
110	是在 tool/Host 之上共享一个 Agent-facing 语义视图，还是只收敛文案 helper？初步倾向前者：共享事实与语义，保留每个出口的 renderer；具体模块归属需先完成包依赖调查。
111	
112	### Q2. 信息预算
113	
114	哪些信息允许默认出现在每种出口，单条结果/通知的预算与去重范围是什么？初步倾向用「本次变化 + 当前阻塞 + 一个下一步」限制工具结果，稳定教学移出重复路径。
115	
116	### Q3. 工具契约调整范围
117	
118	本轮是否允许同时修正盘点中确认的 schema、action 和 structured result 问题？初步倾向允许有证据的窄修正，但与呈现迁移分票，避免无法判断模型改善来自哪里。
119	
120	### Q4. 验证方式
121	
122	除了 snapshot/contract tests，怎样用真实 Agent 或现有模型评测验证「指导更有用且没有显著增加无效 context」？初步倾向复用 `team-tools-model-eval` 的 harness，比较恢复轮数、错误调用与输出量，不以单轮主观文案为准。
123	
124	## 首个用例的最低表达要求
125	
126	Attention 用例至少覆盖：
127	
128	- 自动 follow 的对象、已知原因和普通更新后果；
129	- 显式 follow 后从何时开始接收、历史如何读取；
130	- unfollow 后普通更新停止、direct/责任信号保留、可以重新 follow；
131	- active Claim 时为何拒绝以及怎样解除限制；
132	- 未 follow 的读取结果怎样提示重新订阅；
133	- @ / reply 不会自动建立持续关注。
134	
135	通用机制若不能简洁表达这些场景，就不能算完成。
136

Base directory for this skill: /home/yu/.claude/skills/grilling

Interview the user relentlessly until you reach a shared understanding. Map this as a **design tree**: every decision branches into the decisions that hang off it.

Work the tree in **rounds**. The **frontier** is every decision whose prerequisites are already settled: the questions you can ask _now_ without guessing at answers you haven't heard yet. Ask the whole frontier in one round: number each question and give your recommended answer. Then wait for the user's answers before the next round.

Format a round like so:

```
❓ **Q1** - **<question title>**: <question body, might be multiple paragraphs, including multiple choices>

➡️ <your recommended answer>

---

❓ **Q2** - **<question title>**: <question body, might be multiple paragraphs, including multiple choices>

➡️ <your recommended answer>
```

Word each question so "yes" accepts your recommended answer.

Each round the user answers reshapes the tree: settled decisions push the frontier outward and unblock questions that depended on them. Recompute the frontier and ask the next round. The session is done when the frontier is empty: every branch of the design tree visited, nothing left silently assumed. Do not act on it until the user confirms you have reached a shared understanding.

31	| 出口 | 默认 | 上界 | 位置 |
32	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
33	| Thread read 未读批次 | 20（硬编码 `unread.slice(0, 20)`） | 20 | `ledger.ts:4310` |
34	| Main read 页 | 20（`MAIN_READ_PAGE_SIZE`，最新 20 + 被标记条目） | 20+ | `ledger.ts:491`、`5028` |
35	| `team_thread history` | 20 | 100 | `ledger.ts:2215` |
36	| Main stream history | 20 | 100 | `ledger.ts:1382` |
37	| `team_view` Threads 页 | 20 | 100 | `ledger.ts:2376` |
38	| `team_inbox` | 50 | 100 | `ledger.ts:1897` |
39	| `team_task board` finished | 5/Project（`TASK_BOARD_FINISHED_PER_PROJECT`） | 100 | `ledger.ts:203`、`1974` |
40	| Thread 有界主题 | 80 字符 | — | `index.ts:28` |
41	| Main 卡 preview/gist | 120 字符 | — | `ledger.ts:552` |
42	| 通知正文 | 8,192 字符后截断并标记 | — | `surface-visibility.ts:17` |
43	| 工具结果剪裁（历史） | `tool-result-pruner` 8,192 阈值 | — | Harness 侧 |
44	
45	观察：读侧有两套「20」——Thread read 的 20 是**硬编码魔数**（无命名常量、无参数），Main read 的 20 是命名常量。语义还不同：Thread 取最旧 20 条未读（分批确认），Main 取最新 20 条（不管未读几条）。03 要改的正是后者。
46	
47	## 3. 相同概念的一致性（SCOPE 清单第 3 条）
48	
49	一致的部分：token 交接句只有 `nextWriteLine` 一种；拒绝首词只有 `Not committed —`；事实行 read 与拒绝共用 `factLine`；Task 站立只有 `taskStanding` 一种拼法；「去某工具读全文」的路由句全部来自 recovery 注册表。
50	
51	不一致的部分（均已核）：
52	1. **token 出现面的说法互相矛盾，且 `tools.md` 同一文件自相矛盾**：`:75` 说拒绝交还当前 revision、「the retry commits with no intervening read」，`:77` 说「Recovery is still read-and-reconsider: the rejection's facts are the gate」。zh 版把两句并进同一段（`tools.zh.md:59`），矛盾依旧。代码事实：两类拒绝都渲染 token（`rejectionLines`），但 `unread_required` 的重试仍被未读门挡住（除非豁免命中）——见 02 票据。
53	2. **`boundaries.md(+zh)` 与两个 package README 仍在断言旧契约**：`boundaries.md:6`「token 不出现在任何 typed rejection」；`README.md:12`/`README.zh.md:12`「render no numeric revision or write token」——与 `README.md:22`（新契约：token 出现在「a typed rejection that names the current revision」）在同一文件里打架。
54	3. **persona（`cordis.patch.yml:111`）与 core skill 末行**说「a rejection supplies no write basis」，而拒绝结果 literally 渲染 `Next write — baseRevision: N`。
55	4. 分页参数的文档不对称：`team_thread` 的 `beforeSequence`/`limit` 有描述，`team_view` 的 `limit`/`cursor` 与 `team_inbox` 的 `limit` 只有类型没有描述（render 里才说「up to 100 rows」）。
56	
57	## 4. 参数表的开放性与重复文本（SCOPE 清单第 5、6 条）
58	
59	工具框架把参数表编译成 `{type, properties, required}`，**没有 `additionalProperties`**（`team_dm` 的注释 `index.ts:801` 记于此）。因此未命名参数会被静默丢弃，除四处手写守卫：`team_dm` 的 stray 检查（`:802`）、`team_message` 的 `asTask` 检查（`:911`）、`team_thread` 的 `messageRef` 归属检查（`:601`）、`team_task` 的逐 action 参数检查（`:1140` 起一串）。`team_view`/`team_inbox`/`team_attention` 没有 stray 守卫——对只读工具代价低，但这是一个已知的框架级缺口。
60	
61	重复文本（本次新量，编译后口径）：37 段参数描述共 8,766 字符，其中逐句重复的浪费 **3,206 字符（36.6%）**：
62	
63	| 重复句 | 次数 | 小计字符 |
64	| --- | --- | --- |
65	| 「An unambiguous abbreviation of the first 6+ UUID hex characters also resolves.」 | 9 | 702 |
66	| 「Required when you participate in more than Workspaces…」 | 7 | 700 |
67	| 「Target Workspace id exactly as listed in your participation context or team_view.」 | 7 | 567 |
68	| 「A unique prefix of at least 6 hex characters also resolves.」 | 7 | 413 |
69	| 「This does not change your Session cwd.」 | 7 | 266 |
70	| 其余 11 句（ref 格式、body 文风、taskRef 别名等） | 2–3 | 558 |
71	
72	单工具 schema 体量（description + 参数 JSON）：`team_message` 5,827（31%）、`team_task` 4,131、`team_thread` 3,203、`team_dm` 2,012、`team_attention` 1,687、`team_view` 1,054、`team_inbox` 808；合计 **18,722**，与基线 18.7K 吻合。workspace 参数一整段（约 280 字符 × 7 ≈ 1.9K）是最大单块重复。
73	
74	## 5. Q3 证据：已确认问题分级
75	
76	SCOPE Q3 问「本轮是否允许窄修 schema/action/result」。以下每条都有源码或测试证据；分级为建议，不等 Human 拍板。
77	
78	### A. 窄修候选（有证据、改动局部、与呈现迁移可分票）
79	
80	1. **Thread read 批次魔数**（`ledger.ts:4310`）：`unread.slice(0, 20)` 无命名常量、无参数、与 `MAIN_READ_PAGE_SIZE` 同值不同源。建议提为命名常量并注明与 Main 页的语义差异。证据：本节预算表。
81	2. **`team_view`/`team_inbox` 分页参数无描述**：`limit`/`cursor` 只有类型。建议补一句话描述（默认值 + 上界），与 `team_thread` 对齐。证据：`index.ts:294`、`:1255`。
82	3. **Main read 的「20 条全文」改有界投影**——这已是 03 整票，不算窄修；列此只为说明 Q3 的「result 问题」主项就是它。
83	4. **拒绝 token 条件渲染**——02 整票（含结构化探针）。
84	
85	### B. 有意的非对称（有注释与语料证据，保留）
86	
87	1. `read` 忽略 `beforeSequence`/`limit`，而 `history`/`message` 拒绝（`index.ts:629-632`）：注释记「一次真实 session 在被要求去掉后原样重试了两次」。
88	2. `post` 静默丢弃 `kind`/`accountable`/`sourceThreadRefs`（`:894`）：注释记为避免白费一次重试；空 `sourceThreadRefs: []` 等同未传。
89	3. `blankToAbsent` 把 `''`/`0`/`false` 归一为未传（`:207`）：只对地址/选择参数；`body`/`direction` 不归一（空是真实错误）。
90	4. `unread_required` 恢复句让人先 read（`recovery-hints.ts:35`）：与未读门顺序一致；02 改的是豁免命中时的句子，不是这条的现状。
91	
92	### C. 框架限制（记录，不在本工作项修）
93	
94	1. 参数表无 `additionalProperties`，stray 参数只能手写守卫（见 §4）。
95	2. `PreStepDecision` 只接受 `UserMessage[]`，member-context 的旧副本无法就地替换（01 票据已记录，Harness 扩展点问题）。
96	3. `tool-result-pruner`（8,192）只剪工具结果；member-context 旧副本是 user message，剪不到（§1.2 已量）。
97	
98	### D. 明确不纳入
99	
100	- 通知文本（`notificationText`/`dmRelayText`）的整理：`team-performance-optimization` 正在改同一路径，等它定型。
101	- Client/Remote 面：本工作项不改 Human Client；Remote 结果形状是 03 的约束而非对象。
102	- 模型评测重跑：属 04 的验收，不在本清单。
103	
104	## 6. 未覆盖与边界
105	
106	- 本文是**只读盘点**：没有改任何代码、schema 或文档；引用行号对应 master `3d16926`。
107	- persona 与 core skill 的逐句清点归 04；本文只标了与工具面的矛盾处（§3）。
108	- 「输出省略后是否仍指出完整事实的入口」逐工具核对结论：七个工具的 render 都以路由句收口（read/inbox/view→`team_thread read`，rejections→recovery 注册表，board→Thread），没有只给截断不给入口的出口；Main read 的截断上下文入口（`history`/`message`）是 03 要补强的那一处。

content.text:
我看完了目标、两轮修订、契约清单和实施票据。**我的判断：这个 scratch 的方向有价值，但现在把“希望达到的效果”和“准备采用的办法”混在了一起，还不适合直接按五张票开工。**

另外，就这项工作的记录看，之前的“多次优化”主要是**提案和票据的修订**，不是实现已经多轮验证有效。当前代码的独立核对还在进行；下面先讨论目标，不把提案当成事实。

## 这个 scratch 到底应该做什么

[SCOPE 的原始目标](.scratch/active/agent-tools-context-rendering/SCOPE.md:15)其实很清楚：

> **让 Agent 在需要作决定时，得到足够、准确、不过量的信息，并知道下一步怎么做。**

我建议保留这个目标。它既不是单纯“缩短提示词”，也不是“统一所有工具的输出格式”。

要解决的是三类问题：

1. **信息不一致**：规则说必须重新读，工具结果却给出可以继续写的提示。
2. **信息出现的时机不合适**：本来只需要知道某项状态变了，却又收到整份旧背景。
3. **信息与行动不匹配**：给了大量内容却没说清下一步；或者缩短了内容，反而不够作出正确判断。

## 预期应该表现成什么样

| 场景 | 预期表现 |
|---|---|
| 刚开始或压缩后继续工作 | 知道自己是谁、负责什么、可以在哪里工作、去哪里找记忆 |
| 会话中状态发生变化 | 及时知道真正影响行动的变化；没变的背景不反复堆积 |
| 工具操作成功 | 清楚知道提交了什么、结果是什么；不重新讲一遍全部规则 |
| 工具拒绝操作 | 清楚知道为什么没提交、缺什么条件、下一步怎样恢复；不暗示一定能成功 |
| 读取讨论 | 拿到足够理解当前讨论的内容；省略的部分有明确读取入口 |
| 收到通知 | 知道为什么通知自己、需要查看哪里；不把通知变成另一份完整讨论记录 |

最终效果应该是：**少误解、少无效重试、少重复阅读，同时不漏掉重要变化。** 文本减少是这些改进的结果之一，不是唯一目标。

## 现有提案还需要重新考虑的地方

**1. “收到过正文”和“满足写入前的阅读条件”，是行为设计，不只是渲染收尾。**

票据 02 想让拒绝结果里展示的事实也能满足写入条件。这个方向可以讨论，但提案把它称为“不是新的设计取舍”，说得过头了。

它涉及：展示是否完整、之后是否有新变化、内容压缩后怎么办。不能只为了省一次调用，就默认这些问题已经解决。

**2. “每条规则只放一处”过于绝对。**

应该做到的是：**规则只有一份权威定义，各处说法一致。**  
不一定意味着模型只能看到一次。参数格式、危险操作限制、错误恢复，可能需要在使用位置保留简短提示。删除重复文字以后，模型是否更容易用错，才是关键。

**3. memory 方案还没有完全自洽。**

[票据 01](.scratch/active/agent-tools-context-rendering/issues/01-memory-injection-strategy.md:9)一边写“全块只在开始和压缩后出现”，另一边又规定 ownership/workspace 变化时发全块；还保留了一条备用实现。

这说明“哪些信息需要重新提供”尚未说清，就已经进入摘要比较、分支和兜底路径设计了。应该先定预期行为，再选实现。

**4. 目前的数字能证明重复很多，不能直接证明收益多大。**

日志里累计出现了多少字符，不等于某次请求实际保留了多少内容，更不等于真实费用或耗时。提案已经修过统计口径，但仍有把估算当收益排序依据的地方。

后续必须分开测：**实际上下文占用、调用次数、模型行为、成本与耗时。** 暂时不承诺整体降低多少百分比。

## 我建议怎么推进

先不沿着旧票据继续加细节，而是：

1. **选出几段完整协作流程**：开始工作、收到更新、读取后回复、写入被拒后恢复、压缩后继续。
2. **明确每一步必须知道什么**：哪些必须立即提供，哪些可以按需读取，哪些绝不能省略。
3. **展示实际的前后输出样例**：不仅看一句文案是否顺眼，还看连续几步是否重复、矛盾或缺信息。
4. **一次验证一条完整流程**：先证明正确，再比较体量和调用次数；最后才收敛公共实现。

这轮先确认两个根本问题，memory 怎么注入、拒绝能否替代 read 等细节放在下一轮。

---

❓ **Q1 — 目标优先级**：是否把“Agent 能正确理解状态并完成协作”作为首要目标，减少上下文和往返作为次要目标，而不是给整个工作项设一个压缩比例来驱动改造？

➡️ **建议是。** 可以给明确的重复问题设减量指标，但不能为了指标删掉必要信息，也不能只凭文本变短就判定成功。

---

❓ **Q2 — 修改范围**：这次是否允许修正有证据支持的工具行为问题，而不只改输出文字？例如读取范围、参数含义、拒绝后的恢复条件；但每项行为变化必须单独说明、单独验证，不混在“文案整理”里实施。

➡️ **建议允许。** 否则可能只是把不好用的行为解释得更漂亮。但不因此重写全部七个工具，也不预设需要新的共享层。
都同意，继续对齐具体行为

docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:5:## Mutation fences
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:6:Existing-Thread public mutations require the current next-write token in `baseRevision` — an opaque copy-through value, not a fact about the Thread. The model copies the latest explicitly rendered value verbatim and never increments, derives, compares, or cites it. The token appears on exactly two surfaces: a `team_thread read` that leaves no unread remaining, and a committed public mutation (`team_message` start/reply, `team_task` mutation) whose result returns the resulting Thread state.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:10:Host checks: (1) relevant unread must be read, otherwise `unread_required`; (2) the token must match the current Thread revision, otherwise `stale_revision`; (3) closed Tasks reject replies, Claims, and new Attention. Taskless Threads have no Claim or Task-resolution mutation. These are normal collaboration outcomes, not infrastructure failures; there is no force-send or unread bypass.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:12:An exemption sits inside check (1) and only there. When every unread fact is already on the writer's model-visible surface in full, the write is allowed without a read — the notice that carried the body is itself the reading.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:14:The exemption persists nothing: no attention watermark advances, no direct marker is consumed, and the durable "has this been read" answer stays exactly what it was. One fact off the surface keeps the write refused, and a Member with no live Session is never exempt. A rejected mutation still renders no bypass: it carries the facts that gated the write and the current revision to retry with, and recovery is read the Thread and reconsider.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:18:## Ownership and Task authority
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:31:## Human Remote boundary
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:32:The Human Client uses `readThread`, `threadHistory`, `threadObservations`, and `changes`, and it consumes the Host's Human Inbox slice as the 「收件箱 / Inbox」 queue. Attention has two entry points, neither of them model-facing: the Agent tool `team_attention` goes through `changeAttentionForAgent`, while `@Remote('changeAttention')` is the Human Remote — which both Thread faces wire to one shared follow control, so a Human subscribes to a Thread's ordinary updates from the Web surface.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:38:That page renders the Host's two slices. The first is the unread queue 「需要我」, whose counts the badge and header totals describe. The second is the 「最近活跃」 tail of Threads the reader has written a Message in. A reply makes a Thread theirs whether or not they follow it, and so does a Thread they started that nobody has answered yet — a reply does not implicitly follow, so Attention decides what notifies a reader rather than what they took part in. That tail is newest activity first, each Workspace's slice bounded to ten and the merged page showing at most five, never a Thread the queue already holds.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:40:Neither slice names an archived Project's Threads: archival ends participation as well as notification. An Agent's Inbox receives the queue alone. Opening the Inbox page acknowledges nothing — only a durable Thread read consumes a mention marker. `threadObservations` feeds the Thread composer's mention ranking (current followers first); the observation history itself stays unrendered. Browser storage keeps navigation mode, Workspace selection, and the Inbox page position (a navigation fact, not an unread fact); unread, Attention, revisions, and observations remain Host-owned.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:42:The Client merges the per-Workspace Inbox calls in the Client; there is no home-level Inbox ledger or Remote. Each call asks for the whole unread slice — `directCount` per row and `totalUnreadCount` for the badge — and the merged result feeds both the badge and the Inbox page.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:44:## Team Member context boundary
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:45:The explicit `team-member` preset contains coding tools, background jobs, the skill loader tool, compaction, all seven Team tools, Workspace instruction discovery, and private-memory context. Harness `agent-instructions` remains the sole loader for `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`. Each Member private root has `memory.md`, `notes/`, and `skills/`; only a bounded 16 KiB escaped reference index is injected, and the block states its current usage as `X.X KiB / 16 KiB` with a percentage. Memory can be stale and never overrides Workspace instructions, Human input, or durable Team facts.
docs/team-collaboration/boundaries.md:51:The persona states the private-space physical facts (the injected absolute paths, never cwd-relative ones, the memory/notes discipline, and the reusable-assets boundary). It says nothing about managing context: the preset's engine compacts and the Host swaps a generation, so there is no instruction a Member could act on. Anything worth keeping across a generation belongs in private memory while the work happens, not in a farewell before it.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:1:# Memory, context pressure, and notifications
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:3:English | [中文](memory-and-context.zh.md)
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:5:## Member memory upkeep
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:6:`memory.md` is a bounded routing index rather than a store: identity and role, durable rules that must bind every step, what is in hand, and one line per topic cluster, while `notes/` is read on demand and never injected. Members hold the index well under 8 KiB against the 16 KiB hard ceiling — past it the index is not injected at all, and the block always states its own usage.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:8:Upkeep craft (what earns a line, the three tiers, compaction and demotion) is owned by the bundled `member-memory-manager` core skill, on the same pattern as skill craft in `member-skill-manager`. The persona carries only the resident rule that the index stays bounded and that detail lives in the note it names, and a Member's first-run `memory.md` scaffold states the same sections.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:10:## Context lifecycle ownership
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:31:The ordinary swap has one trigger: a wake aimed at an idle Member, whether that wake is a notification, a DM, or an activation at startup or resume. It is strict — the generation must have been idle longer than 60 minutes and measure more than 128000 context tokens — and every fact it cannot establish answers resume, the conservative direction because a swap that should not have happened costs a Member its working trail.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:41:A swap leaves no mark on what the successor is told. Its first model-facing context is the same per-step injection every turn carries — identity, `memory.md`, the Workspace list — followed by the message that woke it. Continuity across a generation is not a briefing: it is `memory.md` being maintained while the work happens and read back afterwards.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:45:## Agent notification boundary
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:46:Host derives bounded coalesced notifications from durable unread state. Idle Agents start a turn; running Agents receive context at the next safe step. Direct mentions include Message body, sender, Project, optional Task overlay, Thread, and Message ref. Task/Claim Activities include actor, transition, and affected Task/Thread/Claim refs. Ordinary unread exposes only a body-free Thread-first route with its unread count; taskful summaries may name the Task. No notice renders a revision or write token. Omitted details remain discoverable through `team_inbox` and `team_thread`.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:48:Hints are at-least-once notification intent, coalesced per Member and rediscovered on restart/resume. A consumed or ignored hint does not create another turn until a later relevant durable change or recovery. Runtime recovery, error thresholds, and the two UI recovery actions remain Host behavior; they do not create ledger authority beyond their documented operations.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:58:**The acceptance boundary.** A Thread read that acknowledges the acceptance of a Task also hands the reader a boundary of its own, but only when that acceptance concluded work the reader owned — an observer following the Thread sees the same accept as unread and is left alone.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:60:The Host appends one `<system-reminder>` asking the Member to move durable conclusions into its `memory.md` index and the notes it names. At or above 128000 measured tokens the same boundary also compacts the generation, once the Agent settles: acceptance usually lands mid-turn, and the engine only compacts an idle Agent.
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:64:## Assembled acceptance
docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:67:The same journey drives the Human's own durable writes: Thread follow and unfollow, whose control reads the Host observation rather than its own guess, and Task transfer to a Project owner, including the mend of a finished Task whose accountable is no longer a Project owner. Real Agent-loop integration tests separately cover safe-boundary wake and direct, Activity, and body-free ordinary notification forms.

7	/**
8	 * Whether one unread fact is already on its Member's model-visible surface.
9	 *
10	 * The write gate refuses writes while unread work exists, but a direct mention or DM notice delivers the message body in full; if that body is on the surface the Member has read it and refusing only costs a round-trip. The probe is narrow because a false positive lets through a write the model was never ready to make: it matches only a Team-authored surface text containing the fact's body verbatim, the shape `notificationText` and `dmRelayText` write. Count-only notices and truncated bodies never match. Reads a live session only; no ledger state.
11	 */
12	
13	/** The notice's own truncation marker, which means the body was cut. */
14	export const NOTIFICATION_TRUNCATION_MARKER = '[Message body truncated; use team_thread read for the full Message.]'
15	
16	/** Body budget of one notice before it is cut and marked; the writer and the full-delivery check must agree on it and on the mark. */
17	export const NOTIFICATION_BODY_MAX_CHARACTERS = 8 * 1024
18	
19	/**
20	 * The text of every Team-authored user message on this agent's surface, newest first.
21	 *
22	 * As in `member-context.ts`, `surface.nodes` holds SessionSeq values while `snapshotEvents` takes SessionLogOffsets; they line up only through the seq = log.length contiguity contract, so the conversion goes through the validating constructor (a mismatch would silently read the wrong events).
23	 */
24	export function visibleTeamTexts(agent: Agent): readonly string[] {
25	  const texts: string[] = []
26	  for (const sequence of agent.session.surface.nodes.toReversed()) {
27	    const event = agent.session.snapshotEvents(SessionLogOffset(sequence), SessionLogOffset(sequence + 1))[0]
28	    if (event?.type !== 'user/message') continue
29	    if (!matchesProducerKind(event.data.source.kind, AGENT_TEAM_PLUGIN_ID)) continue
30	    for (const part of event.data.content) {
31	      if (part.type === 'text') texts.push(part.text)
32	    }
33	  }
34	  return texts
35	}
36	
37	/**
38	 * Whether one unread fact's body is on the surface, in full.
39	 *
40	 * A truncated body appears only as its {@link NOTIFICATION_BODY_MAX_CHARACTERS}-character prefix plus {@link NOTIFICATION_TRUNCATION_MARKER}, so it never attests. The marker is scoped to the body's own rendering: one notice can carry several detail blocks, each truncated independently, so one cut sibling must not un-exempt the others.
41	 */
42	export function isFactOnSurface(texts: readonly string[], fact: AgentTeamThreadReadFact): boolean {
43	  if (fact.fact.kind !== 'message') return false
44	  const body = fact.fact.message.body
45	  if (body === '') return false
46	  return texts.some(text => isBodyRenderedInFull(text, body))
47	}
48	
49	/** Whether a text carries this body verbatim and in full: what follows is not the truncation marker the renderer appends after one newline exactly when it cut that body. */
50	function isBodyRenderedInFull(text: string, body: string): boolean {
51	  let cursor = text.indexOf(body)
52	  while (cursor !== -1) {
53	    if (!text.startsWith(`\n${NOTIFICATION_TRUNCATION_MARKER}`, cursor + body.length)) return true
54	    cursor = text.indexOf(body, cursor + 1)
55	  }
56	  return false
57	}

59	export function surfaceVisibilityProbe(agentFor: (memberId: AgentTeamMemberId) => Agent | undefined) {
60	  return (memberId: AgentTeamMemberId, fact: AgentTeamThreadReadFact): boolean => {
61	    const agent = agentFor(memberId)
62	    if (agent === undefined) return false
63	    return isFactOnSurface(visibleTeamTexts(agent), fact)
64	  }

# Distill Memory

Save proactively when the conversation produces a durable fact, preference, decision, plan, procedure, learning, event, or important context. Do not wait to be asked.

## When to Suggest (Moment Detection)

**Breakthrough:** Extended debugging resolves, user relief ("Finally!", "Aha!"), root cause found

**Decision:** Compared options, chose with rationale, trade-off resolved

**Research:** Investigated multiple approaches, conclusion reached, optimal path determined

**Twist:** Unexpected cause-effect, counterintuitive solution, assumption challenged

**Lesson:** "Next time do X", preventive measure, pattern recognized

**Skip:** Routine fixes, work in progress, simple Q&A, generic info

## Memory Quality

**Good (atomic + actionable):**

- "React hooks cleanup must return function. Caused leaks."
- "PostgreSQL over MongoDB: ACID needed for transactions."

**Poor:** Vague "Fixed bugs", conversation transcript

## Tool Usage

Use `nmem` CLI to create memories:

```bash
nmem m add "Insight + context for future use" \
  -t "Searchable title (50-60 chars)" \
  -i 0.8
```

Add `--unit-type fact|preference|decision|plan|procedure|learning|context|event` when the type is clear.

If an existing memory already captures the same decision, workflow, or preference and the new information refines it, update that memory instead of creating a duplicate:

```bash
nmem m update <id> -t "Updated title"
```

**Content:** Outcome/insight focus, include "why", enough context

**Importance:** 0.8-1.0 major | 0.5-0.7 useful | 0.3-0.4 minor

**Note:** For programmatic use, add `--json` flag to get JSON response

**Examples:**

```bash
# High-value insight
nmem m add "React hooks cleanup must return function. Caused memory leaks in event listeners." \
  -t "React Hooks Cleanup Pattern" \
  -i 0.9

# Decision with context
nmem m add "Chose PostgreSQL over MongoDB for ACID compliance and complex queries" \
  -t "Database: PostgreSQL" \
  -i 0.9
```

## Suggestion

**Timing:** After resolution/decision, when user pauses

**Pattern:** "This [type] seems valuable - [essence]. Distill into memory?"

**Frequency:** 1-3 per session typical, quality over quantity

## Troubleshooting

If `nmem` is not in PATH: `pip install nmem-cli`, or on Arch Linux `yay -S nmem-cli` / `paru -S nmem-cli`

For remote servers: run `nmem config client set url https://...` and `nmem config client set api-key ...` once on this machine.

Run `/status` to check server connection.

input.prompt: 只读、窄范围核对，medium breadth。上一名 agent 因上下文过长失败，本次不要通读大文件。工作目录 /home/yu/projects/dsh-agent-team，先读 docs/README.md。用户正在讨论 agent-tools-context-rendering 的预期行为，尚未授权实现。主 agent 已自行核对 member-context.ts、surface-visibility.ts、ledger.ts 的 deferredThreadWrite/mainReadPage/readMainStream、tool rejectionLines；不要重复核查这些。你只负责：通知（direct mention、普通更新、Task/Claim activity、Main、DM）各自提供哪些信息，收到通知是否确认已读，现有测试验证到哪一步。先 rg 定位 packages/agent-team/src/index.ts 的 notificationText、dmRelayText，以及相关 tests，只读取相关行段，每段不超过 120 行，不 dump 大文件。参考 docs/team-collaboration/memory-and-context.md:45 起。给出 5-8 条源码事实+文件:行号，注明不确定之处，不提架构方案，不改文件、不跑全量测试。工作区有其他人的未提交性能改动，勿触碰。

content.text:
已重新启动 subagent，专门核对通知及“收到是否算已读”的边界。其余几条关键路径我已直接查过代码，可以先讨论，不必等它。

下面是**建议采用的行为，不是当前实现已经具备的行为**。这轮先定原则，具体条数、长度和参数下一轮再定。

---

❓ **Q3 — 记忆与身份更新**：是否把“恢复工作所需的完整背景”和“工作过程中的变化”分开提供？

➡️ **建议是，具体表现如下：**

| 时机 | Agent 收到什么 |
|---|---|
| 新会话，或压缩后缺少这份背景 | 当前身份、Project ownership、Workspace 参与情况、路径、预算内的完整 memory 索引 |
| 自己修改 memory.md 后 | 简短更新提示，不重复整份正文；明确旧副本不再代表最新文件，需要时读文件 |
| ownership 或 Workspace 参与变化 | 该类信息的完整当前列表，明确替代旧列表；撤销到空列表也必须通知 |
| memory 删除、不可读、超预算 | 明确说明异常和下一步，不继续把旧内容当作当前索引 |
| 没有变化 | 不追加重复内容 |

**身份变化不应顺带重发记忆，记忆变化也不应顺带重发身份。** 同时，不因为每次更新提示又强迫 Agent 立刻读一次文件，否则只是把重复注入变成重复调用。

目前代码把这些内容拼成一块，任何部分变化都会整块重发，见 [member-context.ts:48](packages/agent-team/src/member-context.ts:48)。

---

❓ **Q4 — 读取讨论**：是否让 `read` 同时满足“处理新增内容”和“了解当前讨论”，而不是机械地只返回未读？

➡️ **建议是，但区分使用场景：**

- **继续一段正在进行的讨论**：以新增事实全文为主，补必要的回复对象和当前 Task/Claim 状态，不重复大片历史。
- **首次进入、丢失相关上下文后重新进入，或者没有未读却主动查看**：提供少量最近正文和讨论主题，而不是只说“没有未读”。
- **历史太长**：明确哪些内容没有提供，以及怎样继续读取；不假装 Agent 已经了解完整背景。
- **确认已读**：不能因为缩短输出，就把未实际交付的内容一起清掉。

示意，不是最终文案：

```text
本次新增：1 条；剩余未读：0 条

必要背景
  @A：这次先不发布，等兼容性验证结束。

新增
  @B：验证已通过，可以发布。

当前状态
  Task 等待验收。

更早内容未展示，可继续读取 history。
```

这里最重要的是：**“没有未读”不等于“Agent 现在知道发生了什么”。** 原提案的“未读全文，其余只给主题行”不能覆盖所有场景。

---

❓ **Q5 — 拒绝后的恢复条件**：是否统一按“当前上下文是否已经完整提供了所需事实”判断要不要再读，而不是要求一定调用过某个工具？

➡️ **建议是，但必须同时满足这些限制：**

1. 系统能明确对应到具体事实、来源及完整内容，不能靠正文子串碰巧相同来判断。
2. 只要缺了一条必要事实，或内容被截断、已经不在当前上下文里，就要求读取。
3. 拒绝结果已经完整补齐必要事实时，允许 Agent **重新考虑后提交**，不用再读一份相同内容。
4. 这不保证下一次成功：中途又有新消息、权限或任务状态变化，仍按最新事实检查。
5. **满足本次写入的阅读条件，不等于清空收件箱，更不等于事项已经处理完成。**

对应的两种结果应清楚分开：

```text
未提交：还有必要内容未提供。
下一步：读取 Thread 后重新考虑本次操作。
```

```text
未提交：讨论在你上次读取后发生变化。
下方已提供相关变化。
下一步：结合变化重新考虑；仍需提交时使用本次给出的写入凭据。
```

当前确实存在矛盾：拒绝结果给出写入凭据，但阅读检查不认可工具结果中的正文，见 [拒绝渲染](packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts:254)和[可见内容检查](packages/agent-team/src/surface-visibility.ts:24)。修正时应消除这个矛盾，不能换成“照着重试必定成功”的新误导。

---

❓ **Q6 — 规则放在哪里**：是否采用“统一定义，必要位置简短提醒”，而不是“一条规则只能出现一次”？

➡️ **建议是：**

- **常驻说明**：身份、跨工具工作方式、基本协作边界。
- **工具与参数说明**：选择和调用这个工具所必需的信息，不能为了变短而让人先翻教程。
- **工具结果**：这次发生了什么，以及当前必要的下一步；不反复讲完整规则。
- **按需 skill**：详细方法、例子、少见情况。

允许有目的的短提醒，例如参数旁保留格式要求、拒绝时给恢复步骤。**要删的是无用重复，不是所有重复。**

47:When the read left Thread facts behind it, a further line states how many those are, so a returning reader sees the size of the span it is not looking at instead of assuming the batch is the Thread.
63:The split from `team_thread` is what makes the read path carry no Attention logic at all: the three actions share one parameter pocket instead of borrowing a read pocket with three parameters (`messageRef`, `beforeSequence`, `limit`) they can never accept.
103:`projectRef` limits the board to one Project; `mine` keeps only Tasks the reader is accountable for or holds a live Claim on.

content.text:
好，Q3–Q6 已确定。下面继续对齐四个具体行为。这些确定后，再用完整流程检查有没有互相矛盾的地方。

---

❓ **Q7 — 通知的详细程度**：是否保留“直接找我时提供内容，普通更新只给入口”的区分，而不是所有通知都展开正文、或都要求先去读？

➡️ **建议保留，具体如下：**

| 类型 | 默认提供的信息 |
|---|---|
| 直接提及、回复通知 | 谁在找我、原文、所属讨论、回复对象的必要背景 |
| 普通讨论更新 | 哪个讨论有多少更新、读取入口，不带正文 |
| Task/Claim 状态变化 | 谁改变了什么、变化后的状态、与我的关系；原因不确定就不猜 |
| ownership 变化 | 当前责任变化，特别明确新增或撤销；不因此重发所有背景 |
| DM | 发送者和原文；不虚构 Thread，也不混入 Inbox 未读 |

共同规则：

- 同一批更新合并通知，但不能把直接提及藏在普通更新数量里。
- 内容被省略或截断时，明确说明，并给出读取入口。
- 已经完整提供必要事实时，不再机械地要求“先 read”；是否需要读取按 Q5 判断。
- **收到通知不清除未读，也不代表已经处理。**

这基本保留现有通知分工，重点修正重复信息和不必要的读取指令，不重新设计通知系统。

---

❓ **Q8 — 重新进入讨论**：是否由普通 `read` 自动补充必要背景，不要求 Agent 先判断自己应该用“继续模式”还是“重新进入模式”？

➡️ **建议是，不新增让模型选择的模式参数。**

- 当前上下文里有相关讨论：主要返回新增内容。
- 当前上下文缺少相关讨论：补主题、少量最近原文、必要的回复对象，以及当前 Task/Claim 状态。
- 无法可靠判断背景是否还在：宁可补一小段，也不假定 Agent 记得。
- 不保存一个永久的“以前读过，所以以后不必提供背景”的标记；**历史上读过，不代表压缩后还知道。**

背景优先选取可核对的原文和结构化状态，**本轮不引入额外模型生成讨论摘要**。如果少量背景仍不够，Agent 应继续读取，而不是凭主题猜测。

这样，同一个 `read` 能用于继续工作，也能用于恢复工作。具体补几条、选取范围多大，用样例和评测决定，不先拍一个固定数字。

---

❓ **Q9 — 超长内容与已读确认**：是否明确要求“分批提供可以，静默截断后算读完不可以”，即使这意味着极长内容需要多次读取？

➡️ **建议是，读取行为按下面的顺序处理：**

1. 普通消息尽量完整返回，不为凑长度从中间截断。
2. 一次放不下所有消息，就分批，明确本次提供了什么、还有多少未读。
3. 单条消息本身过长，提供明确的续读方式；只展示开头不能算完整交付。
4. 通知、预览、背景摘录必须与完整正文区分，不让模型误认为自己看到了全文。
5. **未完整交付的必要事实，不能仅凭截断结果通过写入检查。**

这也意味着：不能只在渲染末尾裁掉内容，却让前面的读取操作已经确认所有内容已读。返回范围与确认范围必须一致。

续读具体复用哪个 action、是否需要新增参数，下一步先核查现有能力，再定最简单的实现。

---

❓ **Q10 — 成功、拒绝和失败的表达**：是否要求所有操作清楚区分“已提交”“未提交”“已记录但未送达”“结果尚不确定”，不把它们都压成成功或失败？

➡️ **建议是。尤其不能给出会诱发重复操作的提示。**

```text
已提交
  回复已写入 Thread。
  提及 @A 的通知未送达。
  不要重新发送同一条回复。
```

```text
未提交
  Task 已关闭，不能新增 Claim。
  本次没有创建 Claim。
  下一步：查看当前状态，重新判断是否仍需参与。
```

```text
结果尚不确定
  请求中断，暂时无法确认是否提交。
  先核实结果，不直接重复创建。
```

最后一种只在系统确实无法确认时使用，不能把普通错误一律说成“不确定”。

成功结果保留本次操作的必要对象、变化及后续凭据；没有必要的下一步就不硬加建议。拒绝结果只推荐当前确实可执行的恢复动作，不为了给出一句“怎么办”而建议撤销别人决定或重复原操作。
都同意，继续对齐。
Q7–Q10 已确认。剩下主要是几个衔接问题：内容已经看到了，怎样确认已读；补充的背景是否影响未读状态；这些规则怎样适用于不同工具。我先核对现有接口，避免把实现细节变成需要你拍板的问题。

1	# Seven-tool protocol
2	
3	English | [中文](tools.zh.md)
4	
5	Successful and rejected tool results return through the normal model loop. There is no context tool: a Member cannot roll its generation over, record an anchor, or compact in place on its own. The preset's default compaction engine shortens an oversized Session in place, and the Host recycles a cold generation at its wake boundary (see [`memory-and-context.md`](memory-and-context.md)).
6	
7	## `team_view`
8	
9	`team_view` is the address book: bounded authorized Project, top-level Thread, and Member summaries — current addresses, not a work queue; unread work lives in `team_inbox`. Threads are the sole paginated catalog. Rows are newest-first and carry threadRef, Project ref, a bounded anchor subject, and Task standing inline on taskful Threads (Task ref, number, status/resolution) — never a second Task index, and never revision or message count, because neither changes the next legal action.
10	
11	Once the ledger has Project owners (rules version 2), each Project row also names its owners, `@human` first, and the reader's role (`owner` or `member`).
12	
13	Work in flight is not part of the address book: the first page ends by pointing to `team_task board`.
14	
15	The cursor pages Thread rows only; continuation pages render Threads alone, and paging reaches every authorized top-level Thread, including taskless and off-page taskful ones. The footer calls the value a Thread cursor and says whether older Thread anchors remain.
16	
17	## `team_inbox`
18	
19	`team_inbox` lists bounded body-free unread Thread summaries, plus one row per Project whose Main stream holds unread for the reader (the ordinary unread its Main stream Attention covers, plus every reader's markers). Direct requests sort before ordinary unread, then by newest relevant sequence; listing does not mark read.
20	
21	The header states the total unread and direct counts and the number of Threads shown, with a truncation conclusion when unread work lies beyond the bounded list; each row shows its exact unread and direct counts, Project ref, and Task standing when taskful. This is the reader's own unread queue; to see work in flight regardless of unread, use `team_task board`.
22	
23	The footer routes body reading and acknowledgement to `team_thread read`; the render carries no revision and no write token — a current read is the required mutation basis, and it supplies the token.
24	
25	## `team_thread`
26	
27	`team_thread` reads one Thread. `threadRef` is primary; `taskRef` is a compatibility alias for released task-only Clients on taskful Threads.
28	
29	`read` returns one chronological unread batch and advances the watermark. A read with nothing unread for its reader advances nothing and writes no operation, and an identical retry of a committed read returns that read's original receipt with a picture derived from the current projection, because a read has never promised a frozen answer. `history` pages older facts. `message` reads one Message back verbatim by its ref, which is the way to answer a quote whose original sits outside the page you hold.
30	
31	`beforeSequence` and `limit` page `history`, where the Host bounds `limit` to 1–100 with a default of 20. `message` rejects them. A `read` ignores them: its batch is bounded by design — the Host read request carries neither field — and refusing a read that carried one only cost the call, since a model filling every optional slot reaches for a page size it does not need. What a read wants is the next page of unread, and its footer names how much remains.
32	
33	The three actions share no maximal render: reading shows the Thread, and only reading does. There is no Attention action here, because Attention is a different question with a different parameter pocket — see `team_attention`.
34	
35	`message` renders the ref, the sequence with its instant and sender, and then the body whole: this one action exists so a reader can answer a Message it did not receive, so nothing is trimmed and the orientation is unchanged.
36	
37	A read renders five parts in order, then a footer:
38	
39	1. the outcome — acknowledged and remaining unread counts;
40	2. Thread identity and following state;
41	3. orientation — the full anchor when the returned facts carry Host-supplied background, the bounded anchor subject otherwise, and never a duplicate when the anchor is itself a returned fact;
42	4. active Claims only — the current collision surface, one line per Claim (claim ref, owner, direction);
43	5. the chronological facts with inline unread/direct markers. A discussion also renders each derived Task card at its creation sequence, with current status and accountable owner; a card is a projection, not an unread fact.
44	
45	The footer states the read-through sequence and the remaining unread count.
46	
47	When the read left Thread facts behind it, a further line states how many those are, so a returning reader sees the size of the span it is not looking at instead of assuming the batch is the Thread.
48	
49	A history page renders a historical outcome with Thread identity, the full anchor on a first page and the bounded subject on continuation pages, the selected facts and any derived Task cards in that sequence window, and the cursor/hasMore footer — never current Claims or a context recommendation. Every activity fact is structured — actor, Task ref, and the Claim refs an activity claimed, completed, accepted, or released — never a bare kind.
50	
51	A `read` acknowledges an unread acceptance of a still-done Task in its facts and recommends nothing about the reader's context: with no rollover tool and no generation choice, there is no action for a read to state.
52	
53	## `team_attention`
54	
55	`team_attention` answers one question — am I following this Thread or this Project's Main stream, and should I be? `status` reports the current state and changes nothing; `follow` starts receiving ordinary updates from there; `unfollow` stops them. All three take the address and the routing Workspace. `threadRef` is primary for a Thread, with `taskRef` as the compatibility alias, and `projectRef` addresses the Main stream instead — exactly one of the three, and a call carrying both a Thread and a `projectRef` is refused rather than silently preferring one.
56	
57	Once the reader follows, every result also names what established that Attention — starting the Thread, claiming its Task, being accountable for it, owning the Project, being named in it, or choosing to follow. A Claim result and a Thread start state the Attention they just established on the reader's behalf, so the reader learns it now follows without having to ask.
58	
59	Attention is not reading. None of these actions render facts, acknowledge unread work, or hand off a write token, and reading never changes whether you follow it. The result shape carries the address, the scope, the Task standing for a Thread, and the following state — and nothing else, so an Attention result cannot drift into showing content.
60	
61	Every result states the consequence its verb alone does not carry. Following means ordinary updates from there interrupt you. Unfollowing means they stop, while a mention, a reply to you, and a responsibility event still reach you — and unfollowing releases no Claim and drops no Task you are accountable for, so it is a subscription change rather than a withdrawal from the work. An active Claim on the Task refuses the Thread unfollow until it is done or released. [Attention and messaging](attention-and-messaging.md) owns the rows themselves.
62	
63	The split from `team_thread` is what makes the read path carry no Attention logic at all: the three actions share one parameter pocket instead of borrowing a read pocket with three parameters (`messageRef`, `beforeSequence`, `limit`) they can never accept.
64	
65	## `team_message`
66	
67	`team_message.start` creates a top-level Thread and defaults taskless; explicit task intent atomically creates a Task. `reply` appends to an existing Thread. Both accept absolute attachment paths; Host validates and caches all paths atomically. A committed start or reply renders one committed-verb outcome — Thread created or reply added — with the Message ref, the new Thread ref (and Task ref when taskful), and exactly one next-write token hand-off. The created Thread is immediately addressable and the next mutation has its basis.
68	
69	Behind rules version 2 `team_message` also has `post`, which speaks in a Project's Main stream (`projectRef`, `body`, optional `replyToMessageRef` of a Main stream Message of the same Project). It needs no write token; a writer holding unread Main stream gets `main_unread_required` and reads first.
70	
71	`start` takes `kind: 'discussion' | 'task'` (the removed `asTask` spelling is refused with the parameter route to `kind`, never dropped), and only a Project owner may start: others get `project_owner_required`, which names `post`. A non-member gets `not_project_member`. A Task start also takes `accountable` and `sourceThreadRefs`; both are refused on a discussion start and on `post`/`reply` rather than dropped, and the committed start reports the accountable owner it recorded.
72	
73	`team_thread` `read`, `history` and `message` take either a `threadRef` or a `projectRef` (the Main stream), exactly one. A Main stream read renders the newest entries plus any entry that mentions the reader, acknowledges the stream through its head, and renders Thread cards as current state.
74	
75	Typed rejection results (`unread_required`, `stale_revision`) begin `Not committed` and keep the structured refs and counts needed to reread and retry deliberately. They also render the facts that gated the write — the unread batch for `unread_required`, the increment past the obsolete token for `stale_revision` — in the same shape a `team_thread read` returns them, and hand back the current revision as the next write token. A rejected writer learns what changed and which token to use from the rejection itself, and the retry commits with no intervening read.
76	
77	Recovery is still read-and-reconsider: the rejection's facts are the gate, not a substitute for acknowledging them. A mention of a Member the Thread has never carried is not a rejection either: under rules version 2 the Message commits and every addressable recipient is delivered, so there is no undelivered remainder to report and no invitation step. (Under rules version 1 the same write reported the names it could not deliver; that path exists for replaying old ledgers only.)
78	
79	Every rejection — a typed result, a thrown parameter-shape error, or a Host refusal — names the next action and the value that action takes, and those words come from one registry (`packages/agent-team/src/recovery-hints.ts`) rather than from each call site. The registry is enforced, not advisory: a test walks the model-facing sources of both the Host and the tool package and refuses a route sentence written outside the registry, so a new rejection cannot ship with a fault the model has no way out of.
80	
81	`reply` also takes `replyToMessageRef`, which names the Message on this Thread being answered. The Host resolves it against the ledger and refuses a ref that is unknown or belongs to another Thread, so a stored reply always has a parent a reader can be taken to.
82	
83	The link is recorded on the Message, renders as a quote the reader can follow back, and adds the parent's author to the recipients — answering a peer reaches them the way a mention does, without repeating their handle. The Human is never added, because they read the Thread directly.
84	
85	The switch on the Team row's settings decides whether the parameter is available at all; with it off, a reply that carries a ref is refused.
86	
87	## `team_dm`
88	
89	`team_dm` sends a private direct message to one enabled Agent Member in the same Workspace. It takes a `memberRef` and a `body` and nothing else — no Thread, no Task, no write token, and no attachments — because a DM addresses a person rather than a conversation. A stray parameter is refused rather than ignored, so a model that reached for a Thread write's shape meant a Thread reply and gets told so.
90	
91	A DM is pure delivery: the ledger appends an audit-only `team/dm-sent` operation (request-idempotent) while the recipient's live session receives the body as a relay-form injected user message — idle recipients get a new turn, busy ones are steered into the current turn. DMs create no Project, Thread, revision, Attention, or Inbox markers and wake no change waiters. The Human cannot be DMed.
92	
93	The first line of every result says which of the two it was: delivered, or recorded without a live session to wake. There is no automatic redelivery, so a recorded-only DM is never blindly resent.
94	
95	Use DMs for quick clarifications and status syncs only. Task work, decisions, and anything needing team visibility or traceability belong in Threads, and an exchange passing about 3 round trips should move to a Thread because each DM costs the recipient a full agent turn.
96	
97	## `team_task`
98	
99	`team_task` has the actions `board`, `list`, `claim`, `done`, `release`, `accept`, `close`, `reopen`, `transfer`, and `promote`.
100	
101	`board` renders the Host's Task board projection: every open Task of the Projects the reader can see, grouped into To do, In progress, and In review, newest activity first, then each Project's five newest finished Tasks. Each row carries the Task ref and number, Project, Thread ref, the Members on live Claims, the reader's relation (`accountable`, `executor`, or `project-owner`), the accountable owner, whether the reader may accept it, a bounded subject, and the last-activity instant.
102	
103	`projectRef` limits the board to one Project; `mine` keeps only Tasks the reader is accountable for or holds a live Claim on.
104	
105	`finishedTruncated` says whether the Host held back older resolved work; the render states it, so a page never reads as the whole column.
106	
107	The board is current state, not unread: reading it changes no read state and carries no write token. The tool guidance points here when a Workspace change surprises the reader, or before they claim, so in-flight work reads as such instead of a conflict.
108	
109	`promote` turns a discussion Thread into a Task; it takes `threadRef`, the Thread's `baseRevision`, and optionally `accountable`, and only a Project owner may do it (`project_owner_required` otherwise).
110	
111	`list`, `claim`, `done`, and `release` manage only the Agent's own Direction Claims on real Tasks. Taskless Threads have no Claim mutation. A Direction is one sentence describing the Agent's angle; plans and acceptance checklists belong in Thread messages. A successful Claim starts Attention. `list` renders the Task/Thread identity with the active collision surface — active Claims only, or an explicit none — and no write token, because a current `team_thread read` remains the required mutation basis.
112	
113	A committed mutation names its action (Claim created, completed, or released), renders the authoritative affected Claim first — ref, resulting state, owner, direction — then Task/Thread identity, and exactly one next-write token hand-off. Rejection results (`unread_required`, `stale_revision`) share the message rejection form: `Not committed`, local refs/counts, the facts that gated the write, read-before-retry recovery, and the current revision as the next write token.
114	
115	`accept`, `close`, `reopen`, and `transfer` resolve a Task rather than a Claim, and the Host decides who may call them.
116	
117	`accept` belongs to the Human, or to a Project owner who never held a Claim on that Task and only while it is in review. `close`, `reopen`, and `transfer` belong to the Human and the current accountable. The tool forwards the action and the write token and never re-derives that authority.
118	
119	`transfer` takes `target` — a current Project owner's memberRef, `@Handle`, or a unique memberRef prefix, or `human` — and moves responsibility only, leaving Claims with their owners.
120	
121	A committed resolution names the action, the resulting status and resolution, the accountable owner, and the Claims it completed or released. A `self_acceptance_forbidden` or `accountable_owner_required` refusal names its way out from the Host's recovery registry and gains the Task's current state and accountable owner, which only the caller can read after the refusal.

content.text:
已确认。现在有一个衔接问题需要补齐：**既然内容看过后可以直接写，但写入又不清除未读，那怎样清理未读，才不会重新输出一遍正文？**

这一轮对齐三个行为。

---

❓ **Q11 — 已经看过的内容，怎样确认已读**：是否继续用 `read` 明确确认已读，但允许它省略当前上下文里已经完整提供过的正文？

➡️ **建议是，不增加单独的“标记已读”工具，也不让回复顺带清除未读。**

例如：

```text
收到直接提及
  已完整提供消息 A。

Agent 回复
  回复已提交。
  A 仍未确认已读。

Agent 调用 read
  已确认 A 已读；正文已在当前上下文中提供，不重复展示。
  新增消息 B：……
  剩余未读：0。
```

这里的规则是：

- 调用 `read` 才表达确认已读的意图；收到通知、发出回复都不代替它。
- 只有系统能确认**当前上下文仍有完整内容**，才省略正文；否则重新提供。
- `read` 期间出现其他未读，正常分批提供，不能一起跳过。
- 不要求每条回复后立刻补一次 `read`；处理收件箱时可以合并确认。
- `history`、单条 `message` 查询和自动补充的背景，仍不主动改变未读状态。

这不是让模型自己声明“我读过了”，而是由系统核对实际提供过的内容。

---

❓ **Q12 — 哪些出口提供的事实可以满足写入条件**：是否对 Thread、Main、Message 和 Task/Claim 变化采用同一个原则——看事实是否完整、明确地提供，而不是看它来自哪种消息或工具？

➡️ **建议是。** 否则容易修好 Thread 拒绝，却在 Main 或 Task 操作上留下相同问题。

| 当前上下文中的内容 | 能否证明相应事实已提供 |
|---|---|
| 通知中的完整消息，身份与来源明确 | 可以 |
| `read`、`history`、`message` 中的完整事实 | 可以 |
| 拒绝结果中完整补充的变化 | 可以 |
| 明确说明对象、操作者及变化的 Task/Claim 事件 | 可以，具体必需字段由契约定义 |
| “有 3 条更新”、标题、摘要、截断正文 | 不可以 |
| 看板上“Task 当前已关闭” | 只证明当前状态，不等于提供了关闭事件和相关讨论 |
| Agent 自己写的总结或“我看过了” | 不可以 |

**这是统一阅读条件，不是统一所有写入权限。** Main 是否需要写入凭据、谁能验收 Task、谁能关闭 Task，仍按各自规则执行。

也不要求把所有历史都读完：只检查本次操作适用的必要事实。

---

❓ **Q13 — 输出预算不足时优先保留什么**：是否明确区分通知与主动读取的优先级，而不是统一按“最新内容优先”截取？

➡️ **建议是：**

**通知：先保证需要本人注意的内容可见。**

- 直接提及、责任变化优先于普通更新计数。
- 被省略的重要通知，至少明确标出“还有直接通知未展开”，并给读取入口。
- 不反复用已经通知过的旧正文挤掉新变化。
- 优先级只决定本次展示顺序，不删除未读，也不替用户决定哪个任务更重要。

**主动读取：先保证完整理解这一批内容。**

- 未读按时间顺序分批，不为了短而跳到最新结论。
- 当前批次的正文及必要回复对象，优先于额外历史背景。
- 背景放不下时，明确缺失并允许继续读；不偷偷缩成可能改变含义的摘要。
- 无未读时，才主要用于提供恢复讨论所需的背景。

这样避免两种情况：**普通更新太多导致直接提及被埋住；为了展示更多条目，把每条都截得无法理解。**

这三条确认后，我会把已定行为串成几段完整的前后示例，检查有没有矛盾，再收敛为新的设计稿，不继续围着旧票据打补丁。
都同意，继续看完整流程示例。注意工程细节上你自己把握好，不要过度设计与过度防御等了
明白。Q11–Q13 也已确认。接下来只看完整流程是否自然、信息是否够用；工程细节由我负责，优先复用现有能力，不为这些规则额外堆配置、状态或兜底分支。

content.text:
好。下面不再逐项拆问题，直接看 **6 段完整流程**。这些是预期行为示例，不是当前实现已验证的结果；中文用于讨论，编号仅作示意。

## 1. 开始工作 → 更新记忆 → 责任变化 → 压缩后继续

```text
开始会话
  身份：@A，负责测试。
  Project ownership：无。
  Workspace：项目目录及读取入口。
  私有记忆：路径、用量、完整索引。

Agent 开始工作
  后续步骤没有变化，不重复追加上述内容。

Agent 修改 memory.md
  私有记忆索引已更新；先前副本不再代表最新文件。
  需要时从指定路径读取。
```

自己刚写过的内容，不必为了确认更新再读一遍。

随后，用户把 A 加为 Project owner：

```text
Project ownership 已更新，替代先前列表：
  项目 P：owner。
```

只更新责任信息，不顺带重发记忆和 Workspace。

会话压缩后：

```text
恢复工作所需背景
  当前身份、ownership、Workspace。
  当前 memory 索引。
  本次唤醒原因。
```

**预期效果：** 连续工作时少重复；恢复工作时不缺背景；撤销责任也会明确呈现，不依赖 Agent 自己发现旧信息失效。

---

## 2. 普通更新 → 读取讨论 → 领取工作

Agent 收到：

```text
项目 P / Thread T 有 3 条普通更新。
读取入口：team_thread read。
```

Agent 决定处理这个讨论，调用 `read`：

```text
已确认 3 条更新已读；剩余未读：0。

主题
  发布前的兼容性验证。

当前分工
  @B：检查 Windows 安装。
  尚无人负责 Linux 回归。

新增内容
  @B：Windows 安装检查由我负责。
  @human：发布前还需要 Linux 回归。
  @C：Linux 测试环境已准备好。

下一次写入凭据：……
```

Agent 领取“Linux 回归”：

```text
Claim 已创建。
负责人：@A
方向：Linux 回归
当前状态：active
已开始关注此 Thread。
下一次写入凭据：……
```

**预期效果：** 一次读取就能理解需求、看到现有分工并作出行动。领取结果不再重复三条消息，也不重新讲整套 Claim 规则。

如果 Agent 原本不了解这个讨论，`read` 自动补必要背景；如果背景已经在当前上下文中，就不重复提供。

---

## 3. 直接提及 → 直接回复 → 稍后确认已读

以 **Main stream** 为例，避免把 Thread 的写入凭据混进来。

```text
直接提及 · 项目 P / Main

@B：
  @A Linux 回归是否已经完成？我准备整理发布记录。

消息：M
```

如果回答所需背景已经具备，且没有其他尚未提供的必要更新，Agent 可以直接回复：

```text
Agent：
  Linux 回归已完成，结果通过。报告在项目文档中。

工具结果：
  回复已提交。
  回复对象：M
  新消息：N
```

此时 M **仍然是未确认已读**，回复不自动清空收件箱。

稍后 Agent 整理 Inbox，调用 `read`：

```text
已确认 M 已读；正文已在当前上下文中提供，不重复展示。
没有其他新增内容。
剩余未读：0。
```

如果期间又来了消息 O，则正常提供 O；不能因为 M 看过，就顺带清掉 O。

**预期效果：** 不为回复强制重复读取正文；同时，通知、回复、确认已读各自含义清楚。

---

## 4. 准备写入 → 讨论变化 → 拒绝后重新判断

Agent 刚读过 Thread，准备留言“可以发布”。期间别人发来：

```text
@B：Windows 安装失败，先不要发布。
```

Agent 用旧凭据提交原计划，得到：

```text
未提交：讨论已发生变化。

新增内容
  @B：Windows 安装失败，先不要发布。

相关变化已完整提供。
请重新考虑本次操作；仍需提交时使用本次写入凭据：……
```

Agent 不应机械重试“可以发布”，而应重新决定：

```text
Agent：
  先暂停发布。我来复现 Windows 安装问题。

工具结果：
  回复已提交。
  下一次写入凭据：……
```

中间不必再调用 `read` 获取同一句话。后续确认已读时，也不重复这段正文。

两个限制仍在：

- 如果拒绝只提供了一部分变化，就明确要求继续读取。
- 如果重试前又有新变化，仍正常检查；给出凭据不意味着承诺成功。

**预期效果：** 拒绝不只是纠正参数，而是让 Agent 根据新事实改变行动。少一次无意义读取，但不削弱检查。

---

## 5. 压缩后重新进入旧讨论 → 无未读也能恢复理解

Agent 曾读完 Thread，后来会话压缩。现在用户问：“继续处理那个安装问题。”

Agent 找到 Thread 后调用 `read`：

```text
没有未读更新；本次不改变未读状态。

讨论主题
  Windows 安装失败。

当前状态
  Task：进行中。
  @A：复现安装问题。
  @B：检查发布包。

近期原文
  @A：已定位到安装路径包含空格时失败。
  @B：新版发布包已生成，等待复测。

更早内容未展示，可通过 history 继续读取。
```

如果近期原文已经足以继续，Agent 就开始复测；如果需要先前的复现步骤，再读 `history` 或指定消息。

这里不会：

- 因为“以前读过”就只返回“无未读”；
- 重放整个 Thread；
- 额外调用模型生成一份可能遗漏关键条件的总结。

**预期效果：** `read` 不只是清理未读的动作，也是重新了解讨论的入口。

---

## 6. 消息过长 → 分段续读 → 完整后确认

通知先给入口：

```text
@B 直接提及了你，附有较长的复现说明。
下方仅为预览，正文未完整提供。
读取入口：……
```

Agent 读取：

```text
消息 M · 正文第 1 段，尚未完整提供
  ……

续读入口：……
M 尚未确认已读。
```

继续读取，直到正文完整：

```text
消息 M · 最后一段
  ……

正文已完整提供。
```

之后分两种情况：

- **处于 `read` 的连续读取流程**：在内容完整提供后确认对应消息已读。
- **只是通过 `message` 查询全文**：不主动改变未读；之后 `read` 可以确认，并省略已经提供的正文。

如果正文中明确引用另一份附件，读取消息不等于已经看过附件；需要附件才能判断时，Agent 继续查阅。

**预期效果：** 每次输出可控，始终有下一步；不会“只看了开头，却显示已经读完”。

---

## 操作结果还有一条统一要求

以上所有流程都不能把“内容已写入”和“通知已送达”混为一谈：

```text
已记录，但未送达：
  DM 已记录；接收方当前没有可投递的会话。
  不要盲目重发。
```

只有确实无法确认提交结果时，才说“结果尚不确定”。普通拒绝就明确说“未提交”，不额外制造不确定性。

## 这套方案的完成标准

最后不是检查“文本短了多少”就结束，而是实际验证：

- Agent 能根据新事实改变行动，不机械重试。
- 普通更新不会反复携带全文，直接提及也不会被更新数量掩盖。
- 当前上下文已有的完整正文不重复输出。
- 压缩后、无未读时，仍能恢复讨论背景。
- 截断和分页不会错误确认已读，也不会导致续读卡住。
- 收件箱已读、写入条件、Task 完成互不冒充。
- 在这些条件成立后，再比较上下文占用、调用次数和耗时。

工程上我会保持实现与这些流程相称：**复用现有工具和 Host 能力，不先造通用上下文框架，不增加独立的“已读事实数据库”，也不保留两套策略供配置切换。** 如果现有扩展点确实不足，再带着具体限制讨论，不提前铺设备用方案。

---

❓ **Q14 — 整体验收口径**：是否以这六段流程及上述完成标准，作为新版设计稿和实施票据的依据？

➡️ **建议是。** 确认后我会整理成一份连贯设计，替换旧票据中已经不适用的方案；具体接口、字段和边界实现由我核查收敛，不再逐项让你拍板。
可以
我会把已确认的行为整理成新的设计稿，并重写实施票据，保留旧提案作为历史依据。这轮只更新 scratch，不改生产代码；实现细节按现有能力收敛，不再逐项让你拍板。

Base directory for this skill: /home/yu/.claude/skills/codebase-design

# Codebase Design

Design **deep modules**: a lot of behaviour behind a small interface, placed at a clean seam, testable through that interface. Use this language and these principles wherever code is being designed or restructured. The aim is leverage for callers, locality for maintainers, and testability for everyone.

## Glossary

Use these terms exactly: don't substitute "component," "service," "API," or "boundary." Consistent language is the whole point.

**Module**: anything with an interface and an implementation. Deliberately scale-agnostic: a function, class, package, or tier-spanning slice. _Avoid_: unit, component, service.

**Interface**: everything a caller must know to use the module correctly: the type signature, but also invariants, ordering constraints, error modes, required configuration, and performance characteristics. _Avoid_: API, signature (too narrow, they refer only to the type-level surface).

**Implementation**: what's inside a module, its body of code. Distinct from **Adapter**: a thing can be a small adapter with a large implementation (a Postgres repo) or a large adapter with a small implementation (an in-memory fake). Reach for "adapter" when the seam is the topic; "implementation" otherwise.

**Depth**: leverage at the interface. The amount of behaviour a caller (or test) can exercise per unit of interface they have to learn. A module is **deep** when a large amount of behaviour sits behind a small interface, **shallow** when the interface is nearly as complex as the implementation.

**Seam** _(Michael Feathers)_: a place where you can alter behaviour without editing in that place; the *location* at which a module's interface lives. Where to put the seam is its own design decision, distinct from what goes behind it. _Avoid_: boundary (overloaded with DDD's bounded context).

**Adapter**: a concrete thing that satisfies an interface at a seam. Describes *role* (what slot it fills), not substance (what's inside).

**Leverage**: what callers get from depth. More capability per unit of interface they learn. One implementation pays back across N call sites and M tests.

**Locality**: what maintainers get from depth. Change, bugs, knowledge, and verification concentrate in one place rather than spreading across callers. Fix once, fixed everywhere.

## Deep vs shallow

**Deep module** = small interface + lots of implementation:

```
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Small Interface   │  ← Few methods, simple params
├─────────────────────┤
│                     │
│  Deep Implementation│  ← Complex logic hidden
│                     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

**Shallow module** = large interface + little implementation (avoid):

```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│       Large Interface           │  ← Many methods, complex params
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│  Thin Implementation            │  ← Just passes through
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

When designing an interface, ask:

- Can I reduce the number of methods?
- Can I simplify the parameters?
- Can I hide more complexity inside?

## Principles

- **Depth is a property of the interface, not the implementation.** A deep module can be internally composed of small, mockable, swappable parts; they just aren't part of the interface. A module can have **internal seams** (private to its implementation, used by its own tests) as well as the **external seam** at its interface.
- **The deletion test.** Imagine deleting the module. If complexity vanishes, it was a pass-through. If complexity reappears across N callers, it was earning its keep.
- **The interface is the test surface.** Callers and tests cross the same seam. If you want to test *past* the interface, the module is probably the wrong shape.
- **One adapter means a hypothetical seam. Two adapters means a real one.** Don't introduce a seam unless something actually varies across it.

## Designing for testability

Good interfaces make testing natural:

1. **Accept dependencies, don't create them.**

   ```typescript
   // Testable
   function processOrder(order, paymentGateway) {}

   // Hard to test
   function processOrder(order) {
     const gateway = new StripeGateway();
   }
   ```

2. **Return results, don't produce side effects.**

   ```typescript
   // Testable
   function calculateDiscount(cart): Discount {}

   // Hard to test
   function applyDiscount(cart): void {
     cart.total -= discount;
   }
   ```

3. **Small surface area.** Fewer methods = fewer tests needed. Fewer params = simpler test setup.

## Relationships

- A **Module** has exactly one **Interface** (the surface it presents to callers and tests).
- **Depth** is a property of a **Module**, measured against its **Interface**.
- A **Seam** is where a **Module**'s **Interface** lives.
- An **Adapter** sits at a **Seam** and satisfies the **Interface**.
- **Depth** produces **Leverage** for callers and **Locality** for maintainers.

## Rejected framings

- **Depth as ratio of implementation-lines to interface-lines** (Ousterhout): rewards padding the implementation. We use depth-as-leverage instead.
- **"Interface" as the TypeScript `interface` keyword or a class's public methods**: too narrow: interface here includes every fact a caller must know.
- **"Boundary"**: overloaded with DDD's bounded context. Say **seam** or **interface**.

## Going deeper

- **Deepening a cluster given its dependencies**, see [DEEPENING.md](DEEPENING.md): dependency categories, seam discipline, and replace-don't-layer testing.
- **Exploring alternative interfaces**, see [DESIGN-IT-TWICE.md](DESIGN-IT-TWICE.md): spin up parallel sub-agents to design the interface several radically different ways, then compare on depth, locality, and seam placement.

1	# AGENTS.md
2	
3	DeepSeek Harness is an all-plugin Cordis agent harness. Read [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) before changing `packages/`; follow [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md) for documentation.
4	
5	## Pre-stable APIs and released Session data
6	
7	Public APIs are pre-stable; update every consumer. Follow [version/status](docs/session-format-status.md) and [type acknowledgements](docs/cookbook/reviewing-persistence-type-changes.md). [Adjacent migration](.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-31-released-session-format-migrations.md) may add a version-named successor but never move, overwrite, or delete committed generations; predecessors imply neither fallback nor downgrade support. SQLite uses monotonic `SCHEMA_VERSION`.
8	
9	Acknowledge [declared persistence-type changes](docs/cookbook/reviewing-persistence-type-changes.md).
10	
11	Record each externally perceptible breaking change immediately in an [upgrade guide](.agents/skills/dsh-create-upgrade-guide/SKILL.md).
12	
13	**Application launch.** Only `dsh` profiles launch supported Node apps; package bins, demos, and public SDK argv escapes are forbidden ([rule](docs/architecture.md#application-launch)).
