109	### Host sandbox failures
110	
111	If a required `gh`, `pnpm`, build, test, or generator command fails because the sandbox blocks credentials, network, IPC, watching, or nested `sandbox-exec`, retry unchanged with the narrowest host escalation. Require sandbox evidence; never bypass test failures or the product sandbox.
112	
113	### Run relevant checks locally
114	
115	Before pushing, follow [dsh-pre-push-checks](.agents/skills/dsh-pre-push-checks/SKILL.md); report only commands run. After `gh stack sync`, validate immediately; do not merge before checks pass.
116	
117	- Match evidence to the surface: focused behavior tests, model/user-output snapshots, `doc-sync` for docs, built smokes for published paths, and real-API e2e for providers.
118	- Never default to the full suite or repeat a passing check for commit or push. CI owns exhaustive coverage and the platform matrix; rehearse all locally only by explicit request, for CI diagnosis, or for an irreducibly repository-wide change.
119	- `test:coverage`, not `test`, is the CI coverage gate ([why](docs/testing.md)).
120	- Develop with `build:artifacts`; before claiming completion, run `build:check` after the latest `build:artifacts`, or `build` ([layout](docs/development.md#typescript-project-layout)).
121	- **Web browser automation and GIF recording:** launch with `pnpm dsh web --patch apps/web/tests/pin-browse-picker.overlay.yml` to use the [in-page directory picker](apps/web/tests/pin-browse-picker.overlay.yml); omit this override only when testing native picker behavior explicitly.
122	
123	## Secrets / .env
124	
125	Windows packaging/signing: [required reading](apps/desktop/windows-signing/README.md).
126	
127	Real-API tests/demos read `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, optional `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`, and root `.env`. cordis.yml allows `!!js` (never `!js`) under plugin `config` and entry `disabled`; other metadata stays literal, so conditional composition also uses overlays ([primer](docs/cordis-primer.md#loader-configuration)). Never commit credentials. CI e2e skips without a key; [testing.md](docs/testing.md) owns key policy.
128	
129	## Conventions
130	
131	- Packages use `@deepseek-ai/dsh-<name>`; vendor is [rescoped](docs/rescope.md) and `private: true`. Harness packages declare `@deepseek-ai/cordis` in `peerDependencies`/`devDependencies`. Workspace dependency sections use DSH `workspace:*`, vendor/native `workspace:~` ([rules](.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-10-npm-release-sequences.md)).
132	- ESM everywhere (`"type": "module"`). Use package names across packages and `.ts` in local relative imports. Config subprocesses run built `lib/` under plain Node; source regressions use their declared launcher ([testing policy](docs/testing.md#test-subprocess-launch-modes)). The `dsh` CLI source launch runs through tsx's ESM-only hook (`node --import tsx/esm`); modules it reaches must stay ESM (no CJS-only exports) — Node's native TypeScript modes are unavailable across the engines range ([source-launch contract](.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-29-dsh-source-launch-tsx-esm.md)). Raw/Web `cordis.yml` bare plugins must appear in their resolver manifest's `dependencies`; `verify-cordis-config` enforces it.
133	- **Registrations are effects**: every contribution goes through `ctx.effect()` / `ctx.on()`; a registry's `register()` returns the disposer.
134	- **Typed events use declaration merging** and merge-extensible maps. Event JSDoc needs `@mode` and payload `@param`. Public service methods document parameters and non-void returns. `SessionEventMap` members are required-on-read unless the envelope carries `ignorable: true`. Bump `SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION` only when existing discriminators cannot prevent unsafe interpretation; same-version changes require safe reader behavior ([review](.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-10-08-session-reader-compatibility-review.md)).
135	- **Switch on discriminant tags.** Closed unions end in `assertNever`; merge-extensible unions fall through a documented default.
136	- **Waterfall listeners MUST call `next()`** to delegate; returning without it short-circuits the chain ([semantics](docs/cordis-primer.md#cordis-waterfall-semantics)).
137	- **Model-visible ⟺ logged**: anything that reaches a model request must be reconstructable from the session log; a new model-visible input requires a session event.
138	- **Plugins, not loop changes**: new behavior goes on documented extension points; changing `agent-loop` requires updating docs/architecture.md.
139	- **A capability seam comprises Service Definition / Service Provider / Consumer roles.** It is complete, never one role; split only when roles evolve independently ([glossary](docs/glossary.md#capability-seam)).
140	- **Prefer maintained dependencies over hand-rolling** when they genuinely delete owned code and tests ([policy](.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-07-26-dependencies-over-hand-rolling.md)).
141	- **Explicit > implicit at package boundaries**: defaulting is an explicit `resolve(request): Spec` step in the owning implementation, never a hidden `?? default` inside `run()` (the `dsh-shell` request/spec split is the template).
142	- **No hardcoded tunables in plugins**: deployment-varying choices are validated `Config` fields changeable from cordis.yml; a `DEFAULT_*` constant or test hook is not configurability. Protocol constants, external specs, and security invariants stay fixed.
143	- **Misconfiguration fails loud** at load when self-contained, otherwise at the earliest resolvable point; never silently skip a missing referent.
144	- **Opaque cross-boundary ids are branded** (`Branded<B>` from `dsh-brand`), never bare `string`.
145	- **Trust TypeScript at typed same-process boundaries.** Do not add runtime validation, fallback behavior, or hostile-input tests solely for values the static interface requires; validate at parser/config, queued, model/tool JSON, durable/file, worker, process, and wire boundaries.
146	- **No new assertions to `unknown`** (`as unknown` or `<unknown>`). Preserve or reduce the exact legacy baseline; use typed values or validation for replacements ([rule](.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-09-19-no-unknown-casts.md)).
147	- **Source plane vs artifact plane, never mixed.** Static gates and tests resolve workspace imports through tsconfig `paths` to `src` and pass on a clean tree; gates consuming built `lib/` declare that dependency ([layout](docs/development.md#typescript-project-layout)).
148	- **Keep compiler faces explicit.** A package with both Host and Client programs exposes face-specific leaf configs and a solution-only root; repo-wide programs seed a face config, never the root solution ([layout](docs/development.md#typescript-project-layout)).
149	- **Error handling:** use typed, structured failures and localized, actionable reports. Define handling ownership, containment, and failure guarantees; stop dependent work and visibly report untrusted state or unknown outcomes. Follow [dsh-error-handling](.agents/skills/dsh-error-handling/SKILL.md).
150	- **An empty `catch` names the error** and why; keep its `try` to one statement.
151	- **Keep comments local.** Do not restate code, expand unrelated comments, or explain distant behavior without local need ([rationale](.agents/skills/dsh-prose-standard/SKILL.md)).
152	- **Ban `prove` + `nance`** ([rule](.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-26-ban-ambiguous-origin-label.md)).
153	- **Prefer symmetry for parallel values**; unexplained asymmetry usually signals a missed extraction.
154	- **Tests describe behavior, not correctness.** Change obsolete behavior with its tests; explain why in the PR.
155	- **Create Agent Notes only for durable decision rationale;** mechanical/local edits are exempt, including local UI changes ([scope](.agents/notes/README.md#when-to-write-one)). Archived notes are frozen: never edit or treat them as current authority ([archive policy](.agents/notes/README.md#archiving-and-deletion)).
156	- **Official plugin artwork:** use [dsh-official-plugin-artwork](.agents/skills/dsh-official-plugin-artwork/SKILL.md) for official and official experimental plugin icons; obtain designer approval before landing new glyphs.
157	- **Client UI copy is locale-owned.** Route product text through typed dictionaries and `t` or localized primitive props; `verify-client-ui-i18n` rejects hardcoded copy ([decision](.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-23-locale-owned-client-ui-copy.md)).
158	- **Testing policy** — [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md). Every non-trivial model- or product-user-visible change updates a keyless recorded-session snapshot; [snapshot ownership](snapshots/AGENTS.md) reserves the top-level tree for session-driven cases and keeps other expected output owner-local. Fixtures replay on macOS/Linux; fix fixtures, not normalizers.
159	- **Design each tool's UI presentation up front.** Host presenters stay pure; Web cards derive from raw events and persisted result metadata ([cookbook](docs/cookbook/adding-a-tool.md)).
160	- **Plan unit, e2e, and snapshot coverage** for capability seams, lifecycle paths, and transcript output; include missing snapshot-harness support in the same change.
161	- **Both SDKs project the loop.** Agent-loop, session-lifecycle, and `SessionEventMap` changes update the TypeScript and Python SDK expected outputs in the same PR; `pnpm run test` covers neither ([surfaces](docs/testing.md#when-a-snapshot-test-is-required)).
162	- **Choose PR history deliberately.** Split independent changes and fix the introducing PR before propagation. Standalone/stack branches may merge-forward or rebase. Rewrites use `--force-with-lease`, abort on remote movement, never raw `--force`; preserve an in-progress merge-forward checkpoint before taking a newer base ([rationale](.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-02-native-github-stacks-and-optional-rebases.md)).
163	- **Labels:** one PR `kind/*`, all material `area/*`, and native Issue Type ([taxonomy](.agents/notes/implemented/process/2026-08-08-unified-github-label-taxonomy.md)).
164	- TODO markers: `FIXME`/`TODO`/`XXX` by urgency ([semantics](docs/development.md)).
165	- Files end with exactly one trailing newline; `git diff --cached --check` (pre-commit) gates it.
166	
167	## Defensive patterns
168	
169	Read [docs/defensive-patterns/README.md](docs/defensive-patterns/README.md) before changing a package surface, remote service, client component or state, conversation or Session behavior, or lifecycle, concurrency, subprocess, and teardown code. Its [review principles](docs/defensive-patterns/README.md#why-these-rules) apply per artifact.
170	
171	## Type safety and documentation
172	
173	Everything compiles under `strict: true` with `noImplicitAny`; every remaining `any` explains why narrowing is infeasible. Every module and export has concise JSDoc for its non-obvious contract; function-like exports include `@param`/`@returns`, as enforced by `verify-export-jsdoc`. Heritage-declared members, plugin-protocol slots, and constructors keep their docs at the declaring Service Definition, protocol, or class.
174	
175	Comments and docs state complete contracts and context, not reasoning transcripts. Use direct, concrete terms. Do not use metaphors. Before writing `contract`, `boundary`, or `shape`, ask whether a more exact term names the subject: write `response fields`, `JSON validation`, or `ESM exports` instead of `response shape`, `validation boundary`, or `module shape`. Keep `contract` for preconditions, postconditions, invariants, compatibility promises, and other obligations that callers, callees, implementers, providers, producers, or consumers rely on. Keep a literal process, wire, security, transaction, or lifecycle boundary. Do not narrate control flow or tests, preserve review history, or restate code. Keep behavior, failure, timing, ownership, and safe-use facts; link the rationale. Use [dsh-prose-standard](.agents/skills/dsh-prose-standard/SKILL.md) for decisions. Wire mechanically checkable invariants into an executed top-level gate and prove each changed acceptance path rejects an invalid case. Use narrow, justified exceptions instead of disabling a rule globally.
176	
177	Docs accompany every code change: update affected README and JSDoc contracts together. Routine bilingual work follows [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md); only explicit user invocation may run `dsh-translate-docs`. Current-state prose, one physical line per paragraph, one home per fact, and word budgets live there.
178	
179	## Editing these instructions
180	
181	`CLAUDE.md` symlinks `AGENTS.md` at root and `packages/`; edit the real file. Keep each rule self-contained while linking high-level docs. Condense when clarity survives; raise a `verify-doc-budgets` ceiling when the required content genuinely needs more space.
182	
183	## Vendoring policy
184	
185	`vendor/` packages are pinned source copies (manifest with upstream SHAs in [vendor/README.md](vendor/README.md)). Update via the sync procedure there; re-apply or retire the logged local modifications; rerun `pnpm run test && pnpm run build`.

5	## Scope
6	This document records maintenance workflows for the repository. Exact command definitions remain authoritative in the root `package.json`, package manifests, and `scripts/`; update configuration first when a command changes, then update this document.
7	
8	## Start developing
9	This repository is an independent external DSH bundle. End users install the published package; local development and real Web verification require the adjacent `../deepseek-harness` checkout.
10	
11	```text
12	../
13	├── deepseek-harness/
14	└── dsh-agent-team/
15	```
16	
17	Install dependencies with the command specified by the root README:
18	
19	```sh
20	corepack pnpm install
21	```
22	
23	`pnpm-workspace.yaml` does not declare `packages/*` as workspace members: the repository publishes one root npm package and its three `packages/*` directories are build targets of that one workspace, not independently installable packages. The file is still load-bearing — it disables automatic peer installation and carries the build-approval and release-age settings this repository relies on — so do not change or remove it because a directory lacks its own manifest. The root `node_modules` and adjacent Harness checkout provide the packages and source mappings needed for local development.
24	
25	## Verification gradient
26	Run the smallest sufficient checks for the change:
27	
28	```sh
29	npm run generate:typert
30	npm run typecheck
31	npm run check:docs
32	npm run check:core-skills
33	npm run check:boundaries
34	npm run check:versions
35	npm run check:facades
36	npm test
37	npm run build
38	npm run lint
39	npm run duplication
40	npm pack --dry-run
41	npm run check:artifact
42	npm run check:public-baseline
43	git diff --check HEAD
44	```
45	
46	Their responsibilities are:
47	
48	- `generate:typert` emits Typert Host/Remote artifacts from the Host face in `packages/agent-team/src/`.
49	- `typecheck` regenerates Typert and checks Host, tools, and Client sources.
50	- `check:docs` mechanically enforces the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md): bilingual pairing with a working switcher, a shared heading outline per pair (the same headings at the same levels), relative links, `#fragment` heading anchors, the per-file longest-block ceiling recorded in the script, and both indexes naming exactly the documents that exist. It covers the four README pairs as well — the repository root and one per package — plus the root contributing pair, each set with its own switcher wording. Run it on its own for a documentation-only change.
51	  - `node scripts/check-docs.mjs --budgets` prints the per-file longest-block table instead of deciding.
52	- `check:core-skills` mechanically enforces the shipped skill contract under `packages/agent-team/core-skills/`: the front matter names the skill after its directory and its description names real triggers, the whole skill stays inside the reviewed budget in `scripts/check-core-skills.mjs`, every relative link stays inside the skill directory (an installer copies that directory alone), and every file under `references/` is linked from `SKILL.md`.
53	- `check:boundaries` mechanically enforces the package seams described below: no file under `packages/*/src/` may reach another package by a relative specifier that escapes its own package directory. `import type` is exempt because it is erased before runtime, and test files are out of scope because they deliberately wire directories together. Declared subpaths such as `@contexera/dsh-agent-team/remote` are the supported way to cross a seam.
54	- `check:versions` mechanically enforces the certified-version consistency rule: the CI tag, the setup tag, the development guide, the READMEs, the architecture doc, the compatibility baseline, and the bug-report placeholder must all state the same DSH baseline (in both languages). That baseline must also be the lower bound of every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range. It asserts mutual agreement, never a hardcoded version, so it passes unchanged on every release lane. Run it on its own after touching any version string.
55	- `check:comments` mechanically enforces two comment rules over `packages/*/src` and `scripts/`, excluding `vendor/`. First, a per-scope comment-line budget recorded in the script (see its header). Second, a comment may not cite `.scratch/`, a work-item number, or an acceptance criterion: none of those resolve for a reader of the published package, and work history is not an authority. A bare `issue #<n>` is fine — it resolves to a real GitHub issue — and so is `Task #<n>`, a documented Team entity.
56	- `check:facades` writes nothing: it recomputes the path facades from the adjacent Harness checkout and refuses a committed `tsconfig*.json` or `.generated-harness` marker that differs from the generated output, so a subpath added to `scripts/sync-paths.mjs` cannot land without its regenerated facades. `npm test` runs it, which is why a fresh clone regenerates the facades first (see [`environments-and-install.md`](./environments-and-install.md)).
57	- `test` regenerates Typert, runs `check:facades`, `check:docs`, `check:core-skills`, `check:boundaries`, `check:versions`, and `check:comments`, then runs Vitest. `scripts/isolate-dsh-home.setup.ts` gives each test file an isolated `DSH_HOME`; tests needing a particular home must save and restore it. Startup does not prune ledger-unknown Member directories; explicit Member removal removes that Member's private memory.
58	- The suite pins one time zone (`Asia/Shanghai`, in `vitest.config.ts`), because time rendering is zone-dependent by contract: a seat states the reader's own clock, so the same expectation otherwise reads as a different hour on every runner — UTC in CI, UTC+8 where this is maintained. The pinned zone is deliberately not UTC, which keeps the assertion sharp: a formatter that reaches for `getUTCHours` renders an hour that is not the reader's and fails here. A date-sensitive test may therefore assert a literal clock time rather than read the runner's zone for its expectation.
59	- The Client bench (`packages/client-agent-team/tests/harness.tsx`) fails a spec whose rendered shipped slot entry crashed: the shipped error boundary contains the throw and reports it only through `console.error`, so an unguarded run stays green while the surface is gone. That bench also supplies what jsdom lacks (`ResizeObserver`, `document.fonts`) and the whole `conversation` service face — an absent observable member is not a missing method but a `WeakMap.set(undefined)` throw in the renderer's hook cache.
60	- `build` uses the restricted Node cleaner to clear package `lib/` directories, regenerates Typert, builds all three source trees, and uses Harness `tsdown` for the Client bundle. The published artifact remains one root npm package.
61	- `lint` runs oxlint.
62	- `duplication` runs jscpd over `packages` and `scripts` using `.jscpd.json`; treat its output as a place to look, never as a verdict, because it reports moved and restructured code as readily as copied code.
63	- `pack --dry-run` checks the root bundle's published contents; `prepack` runs the full build first, so it is a release prerequisite rather than an everyday check.
64	- `check:artifact` reads back what `npm pack` would actually ship and refuses an artifact that would ship broken: stray `.ts`/`.tsx` sources, a missing `cordis.patch.yml`, or a runtime relative import whose target is not inside the tarball. That last one is invisible to every local check, because the working tree has every file. Run it after `build` and before publishing.
65	- `check:public-baseline` compares the certified DSH baseline declared by the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers against every public surface that restates it by hand — both READMEs and the pinned compatibility discussion in the Harness repository. A surface it cannot parse is a failure, never a skip, so rewording a README cannot quietly drop it out of coverage. It needs `gh`; `--offline` skips the discussion read and is for local iteration only.
66	
67	Both gates are publish-time checks rather than everyday ones; [`release-runbook.md`](../release-runbook.md) places them in the order a release runs them.
68	
69	Changes affecting browser bundles, Client modules, slots, Remote activation, bundle manifests, or visible UI must also run:
70	
71	```sh
72	npm run test:browser
73	```
74	
75	Visible UI changes touching Team controls or surfaces additionally run the mechanical design-language audit (shipped-reference tripwires included):
76	
77	```sh
78	node scripts/audit-ui-parity.mjs
79	```
80	
81	The audit compares Team Client CSS/TSX against the design-language contract in `docs/frontend-design/principles-and-language.md`: focus visibility, control rhythm, icon semantics, hardcoded colors, and shipped-reference presence. Run it after any visible-UI change and after every DSH upgrade.
82	
83	This builds first, copies built packages into a temporary profile, starts the official Harness Web scaffold, and runs the real journey with `/usr/bin/google-chrome` (override with `CHROME_PATH`). The sandbox setup provisions Playwright's own chromium at that path when the base image ships no browser. It cleans the temporary profile and Harness test files afterward.
84	
85	There are three explicit preview/verification paths:
86	
87	```sh
88	npm run preview:ui                         # keyless Team fixture
89	npm run test:browser                       # repeatable keyless browser acceptance
90	DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=... npm run preview       # real model interaction
91	```
92	
93	`preview` and `preview:ui` use temporary profiles and storage and clean up on `Ctrl+C`. `preview` always uses the real DeepSeek adapter and fails when credentials are missing; it does not silently switch to replay. `preview:ui` uses a keyless route-only adapter whose fixture does not call a model; an accidental model request fails explicitly.
94	
95	All three lanes stage this bundle and its declared dependency closure into a temporary profile, then name that staged copy as a profile package — the shape `dsh plugin add` leaves behind: a `file:` dependency, a link under the profile's own `node_modules`, and an entry in `dsh.profile.bundles`. The scaffold resolves plugin imports from a computed generation built out of `profile.layers`, so only a staged copy named there contributes the Team rows, and they come from the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`.
96	
97	A command-line overlay is not an equivalent mount. The Host row's Human-profile form is written to the profile document, and the config editor rejects that write while a later layer (a home patch or a command-line overlay) declares the same row — `overridden by a home patch or command-line overlay` — so the form stays unwritable. A staged bundle the scaffold never names resolves neither its own rows nor its dependency closure: every Team row reports `failed to import` with no module-resolution error to read, and the keyless fixture then fails on an `undefined` `ctx.agentTeam`.
98	
99	`test:browser` does not cover the two preview lanes, so boot them by hand after any change to scaffold composition or profile resolution.
100	
101	The browser journey uses a deterministic keyless Host/Client driver. It covers Agent Inbox reading/replying, Human Project and Thread navigation, persistence after reload, and restoration of the ordinary DSH surface after leaving Team mode.

1	# AGENTS.md — Harness Packages
2	
3	These package-specific rules supplement the repo-wide [conventions](../AGENTS.md#conventions).
4	
5	- **Plugin exports:** service packages default-export their service class; function plugins named-export `name` / `inject` / `Config` / `apply` and have no default export. Mixing the forms makes the Loader discard the function plugin's namespace ([postmortem](../docs/postmortem/0001-acp-default-export-drops-inject.md)).
6	- **Optional services use `ctx.get(name)`.** Reserve `ctx.<name>` for declared injections; the property proxy is topology-sensitive, while strict `ctx.get` reads the global service store ([postmortem](../docs/postmortem/0001-acp-default-export-drops-inject.md)).
7	- **Product-visible plugins require a non-unit REAL-composition test.** Hand-built `ctx.plugin(...)` suites are insufficient. Boot test-only `cordis.yml` through the Loader and app/process; mock only external services or nondeterministic inputs and assert model-visible, durable, or user-visible output. Keep opt-ins out of shipped defaults. [Policy](../docs/testing.md).
8	- **Initiator-owned private chains derive, then capture.** Under `ctx.agents.withInitiator()`, recover the Agent at each orchestration entry, derive `agent.session`, and let operation-local helpers close over it. Keep `Agent` and `Session` explicit at lifecycle, session-log, service, authority, worker/process, persistence, and wire interfaces; do not widen a leaf helper from `Session` to `Context` merely to hide a parameter ([rationale](../.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-15-agent-initiator-scope.md)).
9	- **Represent one asynchronous operation with one lifecycle controller or transaction.** Separate readiness, cancellation, disposal, reservation, or sentinel state requires an independent owner or settlement point; otherwise fold it while preserving rollback, callback containment, and quiescence.
10	- **Design Service Definitions for all current Consumers.** Keep tool-schema, Loader, UI, transport, and provider-specific behavior in the Consumer or provider; do not let one Consumer dictate the service contract ([capability-seam rationale](../.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-06-13-capability-seams.md)). Inverse smell: a public service method with one internal caller — pass a private capability closure instead (`RunCodeBridgeOptions`).
11	- **Require a current owner and need.** Tie each abstraction, state machine, option, defensive copy, and compatibility path to a current contract or production consumer, and keep behavior in its owning plugin or service.
12	- **Require evidence for public choices.** Configurability does not justify an unsupported default, public operation set, format, or imported external concept. Use current-consumer evidence or relevant prior art; otherwise require an explicit value or defer the choice.
13	- **Give shared state an owner.** Hang shared state on a service or instance. A module-level cache, a singleton, a global `WeakMap`, or a `Symbol.for` / `globalThis` / `window.__X__` bypass hides that owner; add no new global `current`, `active`, or `selection` singleton, and derive context from the current scope instead.
14	- **Keep business rules in their own package.** A runtime, controller, manager, gateway, or API dispatch layer carries generic orchestration; a business branch belongs to an independent package and attaches through a registration surface or projected data ([where new behavior goes](../docs/architecture.md#where-new-behavior-goes)).
15	- **Write model-facing contracts from the model's perspective.** Prompts, tool schemas, results, and diagnostics contain only task-relevant concepts, not UI, transport, or implementation vocabulary. Pin stable model-visible text verbatim and dynamic behavior through snapshots or end-to-end coverage.
16	- **Enforce a decision in the operation that makes it.** Schema omission, prompt filtering, facades, wrappers, and listener order are not enforcement when direct or alternate callers can bypass them; test denial through the executor.
17	- **Publish state only at its commit point.** Emit each notification and update derived state only after the operation succeeds; derive caches, prompts, UI echoes, replay, and query views from one authoritative source.
18	- **Apply bounds to the complete result.** Enforce byte, token, item, and time limits where the complete emitted or retained value, including wrappers and metadata, is known; test tiny and exact limits, oversized single chunks, and multibyte byte limits.
19	- **Registry contributions prove disposal** through the HMR-safety test required by [testing policy](../docs/testing.md): dispose the fiber and observe removal.
20	- **Specs run concurrently** in forked workers beside other gate processes. Own each acquired port, path, and child process through teardown; a spec that passes only when run alone is a defect in the spec ([execution model](../docs/testing.md#how-specs-execute)).
21	
22	[Naming rules](../docs/cookbook/adding-a-package.md#name-the-role-that-exists):
23	
24	- **Package tsconfig:** extends `tsconfig.base.json` (Client: `tsconfig.base.client.json`), sets `rootDir: src` and `outDir: lib/types`, references workspace dependencies, and registers in one aggregate. Packages with distinct Host and Client compiler faces use `tsconfig.host.json` and `tsconfig.client.json` leaves plus a solution-only root; ordinary two-entry Client plugins do not split ([layout](../docs/development.md#typescript-project-layout)).
25	- `src/types.ts` contains only types — no runtime code.
26	- Tests live at package level under `tests/`, not `src/__tests__/`.
27	- Update package README and JSDoc contracts in the same commit as behavior, and verify them against code with [dsh-prose-standard](../.agents/skills/dsh-prose-standard/SKILL.md). Group READMEs declare subsystem ownership through a canonical English page link or justified [exemption](../scripts/verify-subsystem-pages.ts).
28	- Package READMEs document model, token, and KV-cache effects using the [canonical Model Experience format](../docs/cookbook/adding-a-package.md#4-write-the-package-readme).
29	- Package READMEs put durable consumer gaps and non-obvious maintainer constraints under `## Known Limitations and Deferred Work`; ordinary cleanup stays in its TODO or Agent Note. Packages with none use a justified [allowlist entry](../scripts/verify-package-readme-limitations.ts).

# Agent 工具与上下文呈现：已确认设计

**确认日期：2026-10-29。** Human 已确认目标、具体行为和六段完整流程；本稿将讨论整理为实施依据。**实现尚未开始**，本稿不描述当前产品行为；现行行为仍以源码、测试和正式文档为准。

## 1. 目标与范围

首要目标是 Agent 正确理解当前状态并完成协作；其次是减少重复上下文、重复读取和无效重试。不以整体压缩比例驱动改造，不因文字缩短就判定成功。

范围覆盖七个 Team 工具、Agent 通知、Member 动态 context、persona 与 core skills。有证据的行为问题可以修正，但行为变化与文案整理分别验证。保留七个工具的职责、权限、Attention 和 Task/Claim 语义；不改 Human Web Client 交互、不改 Harness 仓库、agent loop 或 shipped defaults。

工程细节由实施者决定：优先复用现有能力，选能够长期保留的最简单实现，不为假设需求引入通用框架、配置开关、备用实现或独立事实数据库。

## 2. 三个不同的状态

| 状态 | 含义 | 不意味着什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 当前上下文已提供某事实 | 来源和对象明确，必要内容完整出现在本次模型可用的上下文中 | 不等于模型理解正确，不等于持久已读 |
| 已确认已读 | 显式 `read` 确认的事实，由 Host 写入既有阅读状态 | 不等于事项完成，不改变 Attention |
| 操作已提交 | Host 按当前权限、状态及并发条件提交操作 | 不等于通知送达，不顺带清除未读 |

收到通知、发回复、`history`、`message` 查询和自动背景补充都不主动确认已读。`read` 可以省略当前上下文里已经完整提供的正文，但必须明确确认了哪些内容、哪些正文被省略、还有多少未读。

历史已读不会因压缩而撤销；压缩可能导致 Agent 缺少工作背景，需要重新提供。当前上下文中的完整性只是本次阅读条件的依据，不建立第二套持久未读状态。

## 3. Member 背景与记忆

- 新会话或上下文缺少起步背景时，提供当前身份、Project ownership、Workspace 参与及路径、预算内完整 memory 索引。
- 没有变化时不追加重复内容。
- 自己修改 `memory.md` 后，只提供简短更新提示，明确先前副本不再代表最新文件；不强迫立即读取刚写过的文件。
- 身份、ownership、Workspace 分别更新；ownership 和 Workspace 变化提供各自完整当前列表，包含撤销为空或从多个参与缩为一个的情况。
- 不因责任变化重发 memory，不因 memory 更新重发身份和 Workspace。
- memory 删除、不可读或超过既有预算时，明确异常及读取/维护入口，不继续把旧副本当成当前索引。
- 压缩后按当前实际缺失的类别补足背景；不能因为还残留一条 memory 更新提示，就假定完整索引仍在。
- 记忆是可能过时的参考，不覆盖 Human 输入、Workspace 指令和 Team durable facts。

## 4. 读取与恢复讨论

`read` 负责分批提供未读、显式确认已读，并补足必要的讨论背景；不新增由模型选择的“继续/重新进入”模式。

- 连续讨论：新增事实全文为主，附必要回复对象和当前 Task/Claim 状态，不重复大片历史。
- 首次进入、压缩后背景缺失、无未读但主动查看：提供讨论主题、少量最近原文、必要引用对象和当前状态。
- 背景判断使用当前上下文，不用永久的“以前读过”标记。无法可靠判断时补少量背景，不默认模型记得。
- 背景选取使用原文和既有结构化状态；不额外调用模型生成摘要。
- 背景、当前状态、未读事实明确区分。背景不主动推进阅读状态，也不把 Thread card 当成已读完其 Thread。
- 当前批次的正文及必要回复对象优先于额外背景。未提供的历史和附件给出入口；完整消息不代表附件已读。
- 未读按时间顺序分批，不为了展示最新结论跳过旧的必要事实。

### 4.1 长内容

普通消息尽量完整返回；一批放不下就减少条数。单条本身过长时，明确分段和续读入口，不静默截断。

完整提供之前不确认该消息已读，不凭其预览满足写入条件。`read` 续读在完整提供后确认相应消息；`message` 续读保持查询性质，之后可由 `read` 确认并省略重复正文。一次调用必须前进或明确指向可用的续读动作，不能反复返回同一开头。

返回范围与确认范围必须来自同一次选择。不能先确认整批，再在 renderer 末尾裁掉正文。旧的“最多若干条”不能冒充总文本长度预算。具体预算在实现时按现有约定和样例测定，不新增用户配置。

### 4.2 已提供内容的确认

`read` 是唯一显式确认入口，不新增独立“标记已读”工具。确认当前上下文中完整可见的事实时可以不重复正文；新到的或已不完整可见的内容照常提供。无需每次回复后立刻补调用，可在处理 Inbox 时合并确认。

## 5. 写入条件与错误恢复

对 Thread、Main 和 Task/Claim 使用一致的“所需事实是否完整提供”原则，但不统一它们本来不同的权限或 revision 要求。Main 不因本工作项新增 Thread 写入凭据。

可以满足相应阅读条件的内容：来源和对象明确的完整通知、`read/history/message` 结果、拒绝结果中的完整变化，以及具有必要字段的 Task/Claim 事件。只检查本次操作适用的必要事实，不要求读完全部历史。

不能据以判定完整提供：数量、标题、摘要、截断正文、模型自己的总结或“我看过了”。看板上的当前状态只证明当前状态，不代表相关事件或讨论已提供。

- 拒绝结果完整补齐必要事实后，允许 Agent 重新考虑并提交，不强制重复读取相同内容。
- 结果未补齐时，明确缺失与读取入口，不提供暗示可直接写的凭据或恢复句。
- 凭据不保证成功。提交时仍检查最新未读、权限、Thread revision 和 Task 状态。
- 仅满足写入条件不写持久已读、不消费未读标记。
- 不保留正文子串匹配作为备用判断。必须对应具体事实及实际可见内容，短消息不能因别处出现 `ok` 而误命中。

## 6. 通知

| 类型 | 默认内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 直接提及或回复通知 | 发送者、原文、所属讨论、消息定位、必要回复背景 |
| 普通更新 | Thread/Main 入口及未读数量，不复制正文 |
| Task/Claim 变化 | 操作者、对象、实际变化、变化后状态和与读者的关系；不猜原因 |
| ownership 变化 | 新增或撤销的责任，不顺带重发全部背景 |
| DM | 发送者和原文；不虚构 Thread、不计入 Inbox |

同批合并；直接提及和责任变化优先于普通计数。重要内容被省略时明确说明还有直接信号未展开，并给入口。既有已通知正文不得反复挤占新变化；重启/恢复保留既有可重派生投递语义，不新增投递数据库。

通知预算约束整体输出，包含外层说明和读取入口。正文截断与其完整性判断一致。已提供必要事实时，不统一追加“必须先 read”；是否需要读取按当前缺失决定。通知不确认已读。

通知派发性能由并行工作项负责；本工作项不另写派发器。实施通知票前核实那条线的最新实现，避免覆盖其改动。

## 7. 工具结果与规则放置

### 7.1 操作结果

明确区分：已提交、未提交、已记录但未送达，以及确实无法确认的提交结果。

- 成功给本次变化、必要对象标识和后续凭据，不重放全部正文或规则；没有必要下一步时不硬加建议。
- 部分投递失败不冒充操作未提交，不诱导重发已写入的内容。
- 拒绝说明原因及当前可执行恢复；需要重新判断时不说“原样重试”。
- 只有实际证据不足以判定提交结果时才说“不确定”；不用通用 catch 把所有错误改成不确定，也不为此前未遇到的错误增加完整重试框架。

### 7.2 七工具职责

`team_view` 提供地址目录，`team_inbox` 提供未读入口，`team_attention` 管关注，`team_thread` 提供读取和显式已读确认，`team_message` 管公开发言，`team_dm` 管直接投递，`team_task` 管工作状态。目录、看板和关注结果不扩张成正文读取或第二套写入依据。

### 7.3 规则

规则统一定义，但允许使用位置的必要短提醒：persona 放跨工具规则，工具说明放选择及调用所需契约，参数说明保留必要格式，结果说明本次状态和恢复，core skill 放详细方法和少见情况。不得为了去重让基本调用先依赖读教程。

## 8. 工程落点

Host module 保有事实、权限、阅读提交与写入检查的 interface；tool module 负责参数、Agent 结果和文本。Client 不解析这些文本。共享的内部 module 只承担当前真实重复的完整性判断或渲染，不建通用 Agent-facing 语义框架。

实施依据和 Harness interface 核对见 [工程核对](materials/2026-10-29-implementation-notes.md)。尤其注意：canonical 工具结果不自动持久化；当前 surface 中的最终文本才参与判断；裁剪后 `meta` 可能原样留下，不能只信 `meta`。复用 Session 记录，不建独立的已读事实库。

读取批次与确认需要在 Host 中协调。必要时增加窄的 Agent-owned 读取 interface，复用既有 Host 提交；不让 Session 可见性成为 ledger 重放的输入，不从 Agent renderer 更改 Human 读取行为。既有持久记录保持可重放，不为文案优化改变旧 operation 的解释。

现有公开 seam 不足时先记录具体限制再决定；不访问私有字段、不修改 Harness、不虚构已经存在的承诺。结构选择、字段、预算和内部测试由实施者决定，无需逐项交 Human 拍板。

## 9. 完整流程与验收

[六段完整流程](materials/2026-10-29-accepted-flows.md)是行为验收入口，不是仅比较措辞的 snapshot。

1. 起步、记忆更新、责任变化、压缩后恢复。
2. 普通更新、读取、理解当前分工、领取工作。
3. 直接提及、无需重复正文即可回复、稍后显式确认已读。
4. 旧状态写入被拒、收到完整变化、修改行动后提交。
5. 压缩后进入旧讨论、无未读也能恢复背景。
6. 长消息分段、可继续读取、完整后按动作性质确认。

实现检查使用真实累计的 Session surface；覆盖裁剪、压缩、重启、短正文、跨 Thread 同文、旧凭据、新消息并发、memory 异常及通知上限。只覆盖现实生命周期与公开输入，不为类型已保证的内部值叠防御测试。

模型评测复用既有 harness，使用隔离的合成场景，不上传个人会话语料；接入模型前核实本轮可用且获授权的配置，不复用归档中的凭据。关键指标是目标完成、根据新事实改行动、误调用与恢复次数，其后才是上下文 token/字符、总调用数与耗时。比较同一版本窗口和场景，重复运行并报告样本及波动，不承诺未测的成本比例。

## 10. 实施与完成条件

当前可开始的实施票为 01、02；其后按 [README 的依赖顺序](README.md#实施顺序)推进。每票包含行为、可见输出、测试及受影响正式文档，不先搭横向框架再等最后集成。

完成要求：六段流程成立；关键新事实不丢失；无无效凭据指引、错误确认或重复读取循环；模型评测不出现未解释的正确性回退；相关旧路径与矛盾规则删除；双语正式文档和 CHANGELOG 同步；仅在影响 assembled Web/Remote 等面时运行相应浏览器检查。

本次批准的是设计整理，不是生产实现、模型付费调用、提交或发布授权。设计检查通过不等于上述实现验收通过。

# 工程核对与旧方案替代关系

日期：2026-10-29。Team HEAD 为 `3d16926`；工作副本中 `package.json`、Host `index.ts` 和性能基准脚本有其他工作项改动，本轮没有修改。Harness 相邻源码的 package 版本为 `0.2.1-rc.2`，与 Team 声明的范围相符；未运行安装或构建，不能据此声称已认证全部运行时能力。

本文记录设计阶段查到的事实和实施顺序，不是已实现方案。行为决定以 [spec](../spec.md) 为准。

## 1. 已核对的公开能力

| 需求 | 当前能力与证据 | 实施结论 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 获取当前模型可见内容 | Harness `Session.surface.nodes`、`snapshotEvents`、`deriveEventMessage`；`packages/core/session/src/index.ts` | 从当前 surface 派生，读取应用了投影的消息；不扫描全日志当成当前上下文 |
| 识别 Team 通知 | Team `context-source.ts`、`member-context.ts`、`surface-visibility.ts`；Harness `MessageSourceMap` 可扩展 | 复用 producer attribution；如需附事实标识，放在 Team 自有声明中，不修改 Harness |
| 核对工具返回 | Harness `tool/result` 有最终 `message` 与可选 `meta`；调用由 callId 关联 `tool/call` | canonical value 不持久化，不能假设能从日志读回原始 structured result |
| 工具输出阶段 | Harness `ToolOutputDefinition.render/presentationMeta`，`projectContent/finalizeContent` | 输出内容与 metadata 不等同于最终模型看到的内容；不用展示 metadata 单独证明完整性 |
| 裁剪后的事实识别 | `compaction-tool-result-pruner` 重写 content，但复制原事件其余字段 | meta 保留不表示正文保留；当前投影文本与具体事实均须对应 |
| pre-step 注入 | `PreStepDecision` 提供 `messages: UserMessage[]`，不提供 producer-local replace 指令 | 采用分类增量注入；不把“每步替换原块”写成已经验证的能力 |
| Thread 已读提交 | Team `prepareReadReceiptFrom` 与 `validateThreadReadReceipt` 当前重放同一批次规则 | 不能直接修改固定批次导致旧 receipt 重放不一致；新 Agent 选择要有可持久重放的精确范围 |
| Main 已读提交 | Team `readMainStream` 支持 readThroughSequence，默认未读分批；`mainReadPage` 提供最近页和被消费旧标记 | Agent 展示策略不能先确认后裁剪；保留 Human Remote 现有读取行为 |
| 单消息读取 | `AgentTeamReadMessageRequest` 仅接受身份，无片段游标；`readMessage` 返回完整 body | 分段续读不是现成能力；在现有 `team_thread` 内补窄 interface，不新建第八个工具 |

关键源码入口（均按函数名定位，避免依赖后续漂移的行号）：

- Team：`packages/agent-team/src/member-context.ts`、`surface-visibility.ts`、`ledger.ts` 的 `prepareReadReceiptFrom`、`prepareReadFrom`、`mainReadPage`、`deferredThreadWrite`；`packages/tool-agent-team/src/index.ts` 的 `rejectionLines` 与 `teamThread`。
- Harness：`packages/core/session/src/types.ts` 的 `tool/result`；`packages/core/session/src/index.ts` 的 `deriveEventMessage`；`packages/core/tools/src/index.ts` 的 `ToolOutputDefinition` 和 `ToolExecutionSuccess`；`packages/compaction/compaction-tool-result-pruner/src/index.ts` 的 `pruneSession`；`packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts` 的 `PreStepDecision`。

## 2. 采用的实现方向

### 2.1 当前可见事实

扩展已有 surface visibility module 的内部 interface，而不是创建单独的“已读事实数据库”。一次操作读取当前 surface 并复用结果，不为每条事实重扫整段会话。

对工具结果，使用 Team 工具身份、已持久化的内容及具体事实身份核对。对通知，复用 Team producer 和结构化来源。只有完整的、可对应的内容才供阅读检查和省略正文使用；模型自己写的文本不参与。

事实标识如何与片段绑定由实施者在票 02 的真实 Session 测试里收敛。优先现有日志字段；确有需要时只添加窄的 Team 自有记录。不可用工具展示 metadata 或正文模糊包含代替完整性，也不加入 durable mirror 或恢复兼容分支。摘要不视为原文。

### 2.2 注入和缺失背景

分类识别当前可见的 identity、ownership、Workspace、memory 基线及后续更新。用现有 source 的 Team-owned 字段或当前块识别，不先建设通用 context registry。memory 提示与完整基线是两类事件；提示残留不能证明基线仍在。

压缩与恢复使用当前 surface，因此无须维护独立的跨会话“曾读过”状态。已有持久已读不因上下文被压缩而回退。

### 2.3 读取选择和确认

保留 Host 权威。读取先选择可完整交付的批次与片段，再提交相应阅读范围；Agent 结果根据同一选择渲染。已在当前上下文完整提供的内容可被计入确认范围但省略正文。额外背景不主动改变未读。

Thread 当前读 receipt 的重放按固定规则重新推导；改变批次必须同时设计新记录的确定性表示和重放测试，不能把 Session surface 写进 replay 依赖。保留既有历史记录的含义，不引入双套运行时读取策略。Main 复用已有序列上界，不因方便而修改 Human Client 的默认页。

### 2.4 长消息续读

复用 `team_thread` 的 read/message，使用系统给出的续读值推进不可变消息正文。默认普通消息仍全文，超长才分段。具体游标形式、单位和额度由实施者决定，不暴露 offset 与 limit 等多套等价选择。

读到末段不自动证明前段仍完整可见；缺段时明确补读，不误确认。正常连续续读必须有进展。若单条大到无法在模型容量内完整提供，应明确报出这个实际限制和读取入口，不声称“已完整读取”；不得为极端长度预建通用大文件或事务框架。

## 3. 旧方案替代关系

旧提案、度量脚本和契约盘点保留为历史证据；原五张票已原样移至 [旧票据目录](2026-10-29-superseded-tickets/01-memory-injection-strategy.md)。它们的 ready/complete 是当时状态，不是当前前沿。

| 原项目 | 新决定 |
| --- | --- |
| 01 两类摘要、非 memory 变化重发整块、保留备用策略 | 分类更新；不随 ownership 重发 memory；不保留另一套注入策略 |
| 02 “render 已落、gate 未落，因此不是设计取舍” | 确认行为变化：来源明确且完整的事实可满足阅读条件；不保证重试提交，跨 Thread/Main/Activity 一致 |
| 03 仅改 Main Agent renderer、只返未读与主题行 | 改为读取选择与确认一致，同时补讨论恢复背景；不得先确认后裁剪 |
| 04 逐工具盘点已 complete | 保留为历史清单，不能作为新行为验收完成 |
| 05 每条规则只出现一次 | 单一规则定义，允许必要位置短提醒；通过实际模型调用验证 |
| memory 累计字符下降至少 80% | 不再是整体完成门槛；同场景测量重复减少，同时以行为正确为先 |
| 先建共享语义层 | 不建；只提取已存在真实调用者的共享完整性/渲染逻辑 |

原始 [SCOPE](../SCOPE.md) 已标为历史；[旧提案](2026-10-28-baseline-and-proposal.md)及[契约盘点](2026-10-29-seven-tools-contract-inventory.md)正文不重写。

## 4. 验证约束

设计阶段只检查文档、链接、票据依赖及引用事实，不把它算作运行验收。实现先跑窄的 Host/tool/Session 组合测试，再按影响面跑类型、正式文档和构建检查；涉及 Remote 或 assembled Web 时必须 browser 验证。

旧语料是滚动增长的历史日志，累计字符不是单次上下文占用或真实费用。复跑需要固定输入窗口、区分 session 与日志文件、读取 surface 替换与压缩。原脚本保留不表示测量方法已支持新注入/分段格式。

参考成熟工具实践：[Writing effective tools for agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/writing-tools-for-agents)。采用其有意义结果、分页、可执行恢复和真实场景评测原则，不把示例 token 节省率当成本项目收益。

# 六段已确认流程与验收矩阵

2026-10-29 Human 确认。下列中文是讨论用示例，不要求实现逐字翻译；标识符、数量、角色和事件均为合成数据，不代表实际 Team 状态。行为以 [spec](../spec.md) 为准。

```text
开始会话
  身份：@A，负责测试。
  Project ownership：无。
  Workspace：项目目录及读取入口。
  私有记忆：路径、用量、完整索引。

后续步骤无变化
  不再追加同样内容。

A 修改 memory.md
  索引已更新，先前副本不再代表最新文件；需要时按路径读取。

A 被授予项目 P 的 ownership
  ownership 当前列表：项目 P。
  不顺带重发 memory 或 Workspace。

压缩后缺少背景
  补当前身份、ownership、Workspace、最新完整 memory 索引。
  接上本次唤醒原因。
```

**检查**：无变化零重复注入；memory 变化不诱发每步重发；ownership 撤销为空、Workspace 多变一仍明确通知；提示残留而索引丢失时补完整索引；memory 缺失、不可读和超预算明确说明。

## F2 普通更新、读取、领取工作

```text
通知
  项目 P / Thread T 有 3 条普通更新，入口为 team_thread read。

read
  确认 3 条已读，剩余 0。
  主题：发布前兼容性验证。
  当前 Claim：@B 检查 Windows 安装。
  @B：Windows 安装由我负责。
  @human：还需要 Linux 回归。
  @C：Linux 环境已准备好。
  下一次写入凭据：由工具提供。

A 领取 Linux 回归
  Claim 已创建；负责人 A；方向 Linux 回归；active。
  说明本次建立的 Attention，返回新凭据。
```

**检查**：通知无普通正文；第一次 read 足以看到需求和当前分工；不重复 anchor；claim 结果不重放读到的正文；普通 Agent 不因 Team 改动获得这些工具或提示。

## F3 直接提及、直接回复、稍后确认已读

以 Main 为例。Thread 仍要求其既有写入凭据，不从通知猜数字。

```text
直接通知
  项目 P / Main，消息 M，@B：@A Linux 回归完成了吗？

前提
  当前上下文已有所需背景，没有其他缺失的必要事实。

A post 回复
  回归已完成，结果通过。
  工具：已提交，新消息 N，回复 M。
  M 未因通知或回复被确认已读。

稍后 read
  确认 M 已读；正文已在当前上下文中，不重复。
  如有新增 O，正常提供 O。
  说明剩余未读。
```

**检查**：post 不要求重新读取同一正文；没有写入后自动确认；未读可通过 read 清理且不重复正文；期间到达新消息不被顺带跳过。

## F4 旧状态写入被拒、重新判断、提交

```text
A 读完 Thread，准备留言“可以发布”。
B 随后发言：Windows 安装失败，先不要发布。

A 用旧凭据提交
  未提交，展示 B 的完整变化。
  相关变化已完整提供；要求重新考虑，给相应写入凭据。

A 修改行动
  先暂停发布。我来复现 Windows 安装问题。
  提交成功；无需再 read 同一句话。

稍后 read
  明确确认对应事实，已完整可见正文不重复。
```

**检查**：Agent 修改行动而非机械重试；结果与恢复句不冲突；拒绝只展示部分事实时要求继续读取；并发新消息仍重新检查；相同短正文、不同 Thread 不能误判；既有权限和关闭状态仍约束写入。

## F5 压缩后进入旧讨论，无未读也能恢复

```text
用户：继续处理那个安装问题。
A 定位 Thread 后 read。

没有未读，本次不改变未读状态。
主题：Windows 安装失败。
Task 进行中；A 负责复现；B 负责发布包。
近期原文：
  A：路径包含空格时失败。
  B：新版包已生成，等待复测。
更早历史未展示，可通过 history 读取。

A 根据需要直接复测，或查询原复现步骤。
```

**检查**：不因历史已读而只返空结果；不重放全部历史；不额外调用模型摘要；没有新已读 operation；背景查询不改变 Attention；再次 read 且背景仍在时不继续堆副本。

## F6 长消息、分段续读、确认范围一致

```text
通知
  B 提及 A，正文较长；当前只给预览和读取入口。

read 或 message
  消息 M 第 1 段，未完整提供，给续读入口。
  M 尚未因本段被确认已读。

连续续读
  每次前进到下一段；最后一段明确结束。

read 流程
  完整交付后确认相应消息已读。

message 查询流程
  提供全文但不确认；后续 read 可确认并省略已可见正文。
```

**检查**：跨多字节字符不丢正文；预算包含包裹文本和下一步入口；中断、裁剪或压缩导致缺段时不误确认；普通长度一次全文；末段不等于附件已读；有多条未读时不能越过未完整提供的一条推进连续水位。

## 结果表达补充

- DM 已记录但无可投递会话：说明已记录、未送达，不建议盲目重发。
- Host 明确拒绝：说明未提交，不称“可能提交”。
- 实际中断且缺乏提交证据：说明结果尚不确定，给现有核实入口，不新增通用重试系统。
- 已提交但某通知失败：说明已提交及通知状态，不引导重复写入。

## 验收矩阵

| 流程 | 主要票据 | 确定性检查 | 模型行为检查 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | 01 | 连续 Session 注入、分类撤销、压缩恢复 | 继续工作时使用当前责任和记忆 |
| F2 | 03、06、07 | 通知→read→claim、状态与正文一致 | 理解需求且不重复领取已有方向 |
| F3 | 03、05、06 | Main 通知→post→read、水位不提前动 | 无额外读正文即可回答，稍后正确清理 Inbox |
| F4 | 02、05、07 | 真实写入检查及恢复、并发变化 | 根据新事实修改行动，不只换凭据 |
| F5 | 03、07 | 压缩后无未读 read、背景无额外确认 | 能恢复工作，需要时主动补历史 |
| F6 | 04 | 分段完整性、连续确认、不会卡同一页 | 跟随续读入口，不误称全文已读 |

先在相同合成场景上确定性验证，再运行获授权的真实模型评测；重复样本并报告波动。模型成功不能替代水位和提交检查，绿色单测也不能证明模型真的理解。

Summary:

工作目录：

因此：

2. Key Technical Concepts

2.1 项目与架构

- dsh-agent-team 是外部安装、显式启用的 Cordis bundle，不修改 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent loop 或 shipped defaults。
- packages/agent-team 是唯一 Team authority。
- append-only operation ledger 是 Team durable facts 的来源。
- packages/tool-agent-team 只提供七个模型工具，位于显式 team-member preset：
  team_view、team_inbox、team_attention、team_thread、team_message、team_dm、team_task。
- Human Team 控制面仍是 Web Client。
- 自然语言输出不成为第二份状态来源；Client 不解析 Agent 文本恢复状态。
- typed Remote 声明生成 Typert 文件，禁止手改生成物。
- 当前相邻 Harness package 版本 0.2.1-rc.2，Team peer 范围 >=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2。只核对了源码/声明，没有做运行时兼容认证。

2.2 总目标，Q1–Q2

用户确认：
- 首要目标：Agent 正确理解当前状态并完成协作。
- 次要目标：减少上下文重复、重复读取、无效重试。
- 不以整体压缩比例驱动改造。
- 有证据的工具行为可以修改，但应与文案整理分开说明和验证。
- 旧提案不是已经批准的实施方案。

2.3 三个必须区分的状态

1) 当前上下文完整提供了事实：
   来源、对象明确，必要内容在当前模型上下文中完整可用。
   不等于模型理解正确，也不等于持久已读。

2) 显式确认已读：
   通过 read，由 Host 修改既有阅读状态。
   不等于事项完成，不改变 Attention。

3) 操作已提交：
   Host 按当前权限、状态和并发条件提交。
   不等于通知送达，不顺带清除未读。

通知、回复、history、message 查询、自动背景补充都不主动确认已读。
历史已读不会因压缩撤销，但背景可能因压缩缺失，需要补充。

2.4 Q3：Member identity / memory / ownership / Workspace

- 新会话或起步背景缺失时提供：
  当前身份、Project ownership、Workspace 参与及路径、预算内完整 memory 索引。
- 无变化不追加。
- 自己修改 memory.md：
  只发一次简短更新提示，指出旧副本不再代表最新文件。
  不重发整份，不强迫立即再读自己刚写过的文件。
- identity、ownership、Workspace 分类更新。
- ownership / Workspace 更新提供各自完整当前列表：
  包括撤销为空、多 Workspace 缩为一个。
- ownership 变化不重发 memory，memory 变化不重发其它类别。
- memory 删除、不可读、超预算明确说明。
- 完整 memory 基线与更新提示必须区分：
  压缩后只剩提示，不能认定索引仍在。
- 不承诺通过 pre-step 就地替换旧块；当前已核对的 PreStepDecision 没有这种指令。

2.5 Q4 / Q8：read 兼顾新增与恢复讨论

- read 不只是清未读，也用于理解/恢复讨论。
- 正在继续且背景仍在：新增全文、必要回复对象、当前 Task/Claim 状态。
- 初次进入、压缩后、无未读主动查看：主题、少量近期原文、必要引用对象、当前状态。
- 不增加由模型选择的“继续/重新进入”模式。
- 不用永久“以前读过”判断现在还知道。
- 背景不确定时宁可补少量。
- 不额外调用模型生成讨论摘要，使用原文与结构化状态。
- 背景、当前状态、未读和 Thread card 分开。
- 背景不自动确认已读；Thread card 不代表读完对应 Thread。
- 未提供历史、附件给明确入口。

2.6 Q5 / Q12：写入阅读条件统一

- 不要求一定调用过 read；看当前上下文是否完整提供所需事实。
- 可以来自：
  完整通知、read/history/message、完整拒绝变化、字段齐全的 Task/Claim 事件。
- 不可以来自：
  数量、标题、摘要、截断正文、模型复述、“我看过了”。
- 看板当前状态只证明状态，不代表相关事件和讨论已提供。
- 必须对应具体事实、来源、实际可见内容。
- 不保留正文子串匹配兜底；“ok”出现在另一个 Thread 不算。
- 拒绝结果完整补齐后允许重新考虑再写，不必再读一份相同正文。
- 不保证重试成功；提交仍检查新消息、revision、权限和 Task 状态。
- 阅读豁免不写 ledger 已读、不消费 marker。
- Thread、Main、Message、Activity 用同一完整性原则，但保留各自权限和凭据差异。
- Main 不因此增加 Thread revision token。

2.7 Q6：规则放置

不是“一条规则只出现一次”，而是：
- 单一权威定义、各处一致。
- persona：跨工具规则。
- 工具/参数说明：选择调用所需信息与格式。
- 结果：本次状态与可执行恢复。
- core skill：详细方法和少见情况。
- 允许使用位置必要短提醒，不为了省字让基本调用依赖先读教程。

2.8 Q7 / Q13：通知

- direct / reply：
  发送者、原文、讨论定位、必要回复背景。
- 普通更新：
  数量、入口，不带正文。
- Task/Claim：
  操作者、对象、实际变化、变化后状态、与读者关系。
- ownership：
  明确新增或撤销，不顺带重发全背景。
- DM：
  发送者、原文，不虚构 Thread，不计入 Inbox。
- 同批合并，直接/责任信号优先于普通计数。
- 重要信号省略时明确“还有直接通知未展开”和入口。
- 已通知旧正文不能一直挤掉新内容。
- 预算包括整个输出、包装和入口。
- 完整事实已经提供时不机械追加“必须先 read”。
- 通知不确认已读。
- 复用当前派发/恢复机制；不另建派发器或投递数据库。
- 通知派发性能工作在途，实施通知票前核实，不能覆盖其他工作。

2.9 Q9：长内容

- 普通消息尽量完整；批次放不下先减少条数。
- 单条过长明确分段及续读。
- 不静默截断后算已读。
- 返回范围与确认范围来自同一次选择。
- 不能先确认全批再由 renderer 裁剪。
- read 连续续读完整后确认对应消息。
- message 续读仍为查询，后续 read 可以确认并省略已可见正文。
- 不能跨过未完整消息推进连续水位。
- 当前缺段、压缩或裁剪不误判完整。
- 每步应前进或给可用入口，不能反复同一开头。
- 工程核对额外注明：若单条本身超出模型可承载容量，明确实际限制，不假称完整、不预建通用大文件框架。

2.10 Q10：结果状态

明确区分：
- 已提交
- 未提交
- 已记录但未送达
- 确实无法确认的结果

不把通知失败当操作未提交，不诱导重复写。
只有真的不知道才说“不确定”，不把所有 catch 都转成不确定。
成功结果给必要对象、变化、凭据，不重放正文。
无必要下一步不硬加。
拒绝只给当前实际可执行恢复，不机械建议原样重试。

2.11 Q11：确认已读但不重复正文

- 仍用 read，不加“标记已读”工具。
- read 表达确认意图。
- 当前 surface 完整已有的正文可以省略，明确确认对象、正文省略、剩余未读。
- 新到/不再完整可见的事实正常提供。
- 不要求每次回复后立刻补 read，可集中处理 Inbox。
- 不让 Agent 自行声称看过作为凭据。

2.12 Q14：六段完整流程

用户确认这六段作为新版设计/票据的验收依据：
F1 起步 → memory 更新 → ownership 变化 → 压缩后恢复。
F2 普通更新 → read 理解需求和分工 → claim。
F3 Main direct 通知 → 直接 post → 稍后 read 确认且不重发正文。
F4 旧状态写入被拒 → 完整新变化 → Agent 改变行动后提交。
F5 压缩后旧讨论无未读 → read 补背景 → 继续工作。
F6 长消息 → 连续分段 → 按 read / message 性质确认。

export function visibleTeamTexts(agent: Agent): readonly string[] {
  const texts: string[] = []
  for (const sequence of agent.session.surface.nodes.toReversed()) {
    const event = agent.session.snapshotEvents(SessionLogOffset(sequence), SessionLogOffset(sequence + 1))[0]
    if (event?.type !== 'user/message') continue
    if (!matchesProducerKind(event.data.source.kind, AGENT_TEAM_PLUGIN_ID)) continue
    for (const part of event.data.content) {
      if (part.type === 'text') texts.push(part.text)
    }
  }
  return texts
}

export function isFactOnSurface(texts: readonly string[], fact: AgentTeamThreadReadFact): boolean {
  if (fact.fact.kind !== 'message') return false
  const body = fact.fact.message.body
  if (body === '') return false
  return texts.some(text => isBodyRenderedInFull(text, body))
}

private deferredThreadWrite(actorMemberId: AgentTeamMemberId, task: AgentTeamTask | undefined, thread: AgentTeamThread, baseRevision: number): AgentTeamUnreadRequired | AgentTeamStaleRevision | undefined {
  const unread = this.unreadFor(actorMemberId, thread.threadRef)
  if (unread.length > 0 && !this.visibleSurfaceExempts(actorMemberId, unread)) return this.unreadRequired(task, thread, unread)
  if (baseRevision !== thread.revision) return this.staleRevision(actorMemberId, task, thread, baseRevision)
  return undefined
}

# Codebase Design

Design **deep modules**: a lot of behaviour behind a small interface, placed at a clean seam, testable through that interface. Use this language and these principles wherever code is being designed or restructured. The aim is leverage for callers, locality for maintainers, and testability for everyone.

## Glossary

Use these terms exactly: don't substitute "component," "service," "API," or "boundary." Consistent language is the whole point.

**Module**: anything with an interface and an implementation. Deliberately scale-agnostic: a function, class, package, or tier-spanning slice. _Avoid_: unit, component, service.

**Interface**: everything a caller must know to use the module correctly: the type signature, but also invariants, ordering constraints, error modes, required configuration, and performance characteristics. _Avoid_: API, signature (too narrow, they refer only to the type-level surface).

**Implementation**: what's inside a module, its body of code. Distinct from **Adapter**: a thing can be a small adapter with a large implementation (a Postgres repo) or a large adapter with a small implementation (an in-memory fake). Reach for "adapter" when the seam is the topic; "implementation" otherwise.

**Depth**: leverage at the interface. The amount of behaviour a caller (or test) can exercise per unit of interface they have to learn. A module is **deep** when a large amount of behaviour sits behind a small interface, **shallow** when the interface is nearly as complex as the implementation.

**Seam** _(Michael Feathers)_: a place where you can alter behaviour without editing in that place; the *location* at which a module's interface lives. Where to put the seam is its own design decision, distinct from what goes behind it. _Avoid_: boundary (overloaded with DDD's bounded context).

**Adapter**: a concrete thing that satisfies an interface at a seam. Describes *role* (what slot it fills), not substance (what's inside).

**Leverage**: what callers get from depth. More capability per unit of interface they learn. One implementation pays back across N call sites and M tests.

**Locality**: what maintainers get from depth. Change, bugs, knowledge, and verification concentrate in one place rather than spreading across callers. Fix once, fixed everywhere.

## Deep vs shallow

**Deep module** = small interface + lots of implementation:

```
┌─────────────────────┐
│   Small Interface   │  ← Few methods, simple params
├─────────────────────┤
│                     │
│  Deep Implementation│  ← Complex logic hidden
│                     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

**Shallow module** = large interface + little implementation (avoid):

```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│       Large Interface           │  ← Many methods, complex params
├─────────────────────────────────┤
│  Thin Implementation            │  ← Just passes through
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

When designing an interface, ask:

- Can I reduce the number of methods?
- Can I simplify the parameters?
- Can I hide more complexity inside?

## Principles

- **Depth is a property of the interface, not the implementation.** A deep module can be internally composed of small, mockable, swappable parts; they just aren't part of the interface. A module can have **internal seams** (private to its implementation, used by its own tests) as well as the **external seam** at its interface.
- **The deletion test.** Imagine deleting the module. If complexity vanishes, it was a pass-through. If complexity reappears across N callers, it was earning its keep.
- **The interface is the test surface.** Callers and tests cross the same seam. If you want to test *past* the interface, the module is probably the wrong shape.
- **One adapter means a hypothetical seam. Two adapters means a real one.** Don't introduce a seam unless something actually varies across it.

## Designing for testability

Good interfaces make testing natural:

1. **Accept dependencies, don't create them.**

   ```typescript
   // Testable
   function processOrder(order, paymentGateway) {}

   // Hard to test
   function processOrder(order) {
     const gateway = new StripeGateway();
   }
   ```

2. **Return results, don't produce side effects.**

   ```typescript
   // Testable
   function calculateDiscount(cart): Discount {}

   // Hard to test
   function applyDiscount(cart): void {
     cart.total -= discount;
   }
   ```

3. **Small surface area.** Fewer methods = fewer tests needed. Fewer params = simpler test setup.

## Relationships

- A **Module** has exactly one **Interface** (the surface it presents to callers and tests).
- **Depth** is a property of a **Module**, measured against its **Interface**.
- A **Seam** is where a **Module**'s **Interface** lives.
- An **Adapter** sits at a **Seam** and satisfies the **Interface**.
- **Depth** produces **Leverage** for callers and **Locality** for maintainers.

## Rejected framings

- **Depth as ratio of implementation-lines to interface-lines** (Ousterhout): rewards padding the implementation. We use depth-as-leverage instead.
- **"Interface" as the TypeScript `interface` keyword or a class's public methods**: too narrow: interface here includes every fact a caller must know.
- **"Boundary"**: overloaded with DDD's bounded context. Say **seam** or **interface**.

## Going deeper

- **Deepening a cluster given its dependencies**, see [DEEPENING.md](DEEPENING.md): dependency categories, seam discipline, and replace-don't-layer testing.
- **Exploring alternative interfaces**, see [DESIGN-IT-TWICE.md](DESIGN-IT-TWICE.md): spin up parallel sub-agents to design the interface several radically different ways, then compare on depth, locality, and seam placement.

1	# .scratch Work Rules
2	
3	This subtree holds cross-session work items: design snapshots, research, implementation tickets, prototypes, and acceptance evidence. It is not an implementation or API authority — current behavior is defined by `packages/` source and tests, and maintenance rules by [`../docs/AGENTS.md`](../docs/AGENTS.md). This file only governs how to work here.
4	
5	## Work-item structure
6	
7	Each `active/<work>/` is one directory with a short `README.md` as its single continuation entry, covering five items: status, last-checked date, current frontier (who is doing what and what is blocked), completion conditions, and the formal-doc exit.
8	
9	```
10	active/<work>/
11	├── README.md      # continuation entry (the five items above)
12	├── spec.md        # confirmed decision snapshot — written once discussion converges
13	├── issues/        # tracer-bullet implementation tickets, one file per ticket
14	│   ├── 01-<slug>.md
15	│   └── 02-<slug>.md
16	├── materials/     # research and external material (keep only what is worth re-reading)
17	└── validation/    # human-confirmed acceptance evidence (see the development doc)
18	```
19	
20	## Ticket discipline
21	
22	Each `issues/NN-<slug>.md` uses a fixed skeleton, numbered from `01` in dependency order (blockers first):
23	
24	```markdown
25	# NN — title
26	
27	**What to build:** the end-to-end behavior this ticket demonstrably delivers once done (user perspective, not a layered task list)
28	**Blocked by:** the tickets blocking it, or "None — can start immediately"
29	**Status:** pending | ready | in-progress | complete
30	
31	- [ ] acceptance criterion 1
32	- [ ] acceptance criterion 2
33	```
34	
35	- **Vertical slices**: each ticket cuts one narrow, complete path through every layer (schema → API → UI → tests), independently verifiable when done; no horizontal division of labor by layer.
36	- **Self-contained tickets**: each ticket can start in a new context without reading the whole work-item history. Avoid concrete file paths and code snippets (they go stale); exception: decision-dense fragments from prototypes (state machines, type shapes) may be inlined with their source noted.
37	- **Frontier workflow**: tickets whose blockers are all done form the frontier and are ready to start; a serial chain runs top to bottom. Tickets that are written but still carry unfinished blockers stay **pending**, so `ready` always means startable now.
38	- **Wide-refactor exception**: when one mechanical change's blast radius covers the whole repository, do not force it into a tracer bullet — order it as expand–contract: expand first (old and new coexist), migrate in batches, then contract (delete the old form).
39	
40	## Lifecycle
41	
42	- **Closing a work item**: close or delete unfinished tickets → move durable conclusions into the `../docs/` maintained documents → delete process material without provenance value → move into `archive/YYYY-MM/`.
43	- **Archive is history**: archived states and terminology only represent the working context of their time and never override current implementation; do not rewrite archives to match new code.
44	- **Transient artifacts**: logs, debug screenshots, and downloads go in `local/` or `artifacts/` (gitignored), never into active or archive.
45	
46	## Version control
47	
48	- **Active does not enter version history**: while a work item is open, its `active/<work>/` directory is gitignored working material. Force-add it (`git add -f`) only when a reviewer must see it.
49	- **Archive enters history on close**: when a work item closes, move it into `archive/YYYY-MM/` and amend that move into the commit(s) that deliver the work, so the archive records what actually shipped instead of sitting in a scratch-only commit at the tip.
50	
51	## Directory index
52	
53	See [README.md](README.md).

1	# Agent 工具与上下文呈现：已确认设计
2	
3	**确认日期：2026-10-29。** Human 已确认目标、具体行为和六段完整流程；本稿将讨论整理为实施依据。**实现尚未开始**，本稿不描述当前产品行为；现行行为仍以源码、测试和正式文档为准。
4	
5	## 1. 目标与范围
6	
7	首要目标是 Agent 正确理解当前状态并完成协作；其次是减少重复上下文、重复读取和无效重试。不以整体压缩比例驱动改造，不因文字缩短就判定成功。
8	
9	范围覆盖七个 Team 工具、Agent 通知、Member 动态 context、persona 与 core skills。有证据的行为问题可以修正，但行为变化与文案整理分别验证。保留七个工具的职责、权限、Attention 和 Task/Claim 语义；不改 Human Web Client 交互、不改 Harness 仓库、agent loop 或 shipped defaults。
10	
11	工程细节由实施者决定：优先复用现有能力，选能够长期保留的最简单实现，不为假设需求引入通用框架、配置开关、备用实现或独立事实数据库。
12	
13	## 2. 三个不同的状态
14	
15	| 状态 | 含义 | 不意味着什么 |
16	| --- | --- | --- |
17	| 当前上下文已提供某事实 | 来源和对象明确，必要内容完整出现在本次模型可用的上下文中 | 不等于模型理解正确，不等于持久已读 |
18	| 已确认已读 | 显式 `read` 确认的事实，由 Host 写入既有阅读状态 | 不等于事项完成，不改变 Attention |
19	| 操作已提交 | Host 按当前权限、状态及并发条件提交操作 | 不等于通知送达，不顺带清除未读 |
20	
21	收到通知、发回复、`history`、`message` 查询和自动背景补充都不主动确认已读。`read` 可以省略当前上下文里已经完整提供的正文，但必须明确确认了哪些内容、哪些正文被省略、还有多少未读。
22	
23	历史已读不会因压缩而撤销；压缩可能导致 Agent 缺少工作背景，需要重新提供。当前上下文中的完整性只是本次阅读条件的依据，不建立第二套持久未读状态。
24	
25	## 3. Member 背景与记忆
26	
27	- 新会话或上下文缺少起步背景时，提供当前身份、Project ownership、Workspace 参与及路径、预算内完整 memory 索引。
28	- 没有变化时不追加重复内容。
29	- 自己修改 `memory.md` 后，只提供简短更新提示，明确先前副本不再代表最新文件；不强迫立即读取刚写过的文件。
30	- 身份、ownership、Workspace 分别更新；ownership 和 Workspace 变化提供各自完整当前列表，包含撤销为空或从多个参与缩为一个的情况。
31	- 不因责任变化重发 memory，不因 memory 更新重发身份和 Workspace。
32	- memory 删除、不可读或超过既有预算时，明确异常及读取/维护入口，不继续把旧副本当成当前索引。
33	- 压缩后按当前实际缺失的类别补足背景；不能因为还残留一条 memory 更新提示，就假定完整索引仍在。
34	- 记忆是可能过时的参考，不覆盖 Human 输入、Workspace 指令和 Team durable facts。
35	
36	## 4. 读取与恢复讨论
37	
38	`read` 负责分批提供未读、显式确认已读，并补足必要的讨论背景；不新增由模型选择的“继续/重新进入”模式。
39	
40	- 连续讨论：新增事实全文为主，附必要回复对象和当前 Task/Claim 状态，不重复大片历史。
41	- 首次进入、压缩后背景缺失、无未读但主动查看：提供讨论主题、少量最近原文、必要引用对象和当前状态。
42	- 背景判断使用当前上下文，不用永久的“以前读过”标记。无法可靠判断时补少量背景，不默认模型记得。
43	- 背景选取使用原文和既有结构化状态；不额外调用模型生成摘要。
44	- 背景、当前状态、未读事实明确区分。背景不主动推进阅读状态，也不把 Thread card 当成已读完其 Thread。
45	- 当前批次的正文及必要回复对象优先于额外背景。未提供的历史和附件给出入口；完整消息不代表附件已读。
46	- 未读按时间顺序分批，不为了展示最新结论跳过旧的必要事实。
47	
48	### 4.1 长内容
49	
50	普通消息尽量完整返回；一批放不下就减少条数。单条本身过长时，明确分段和续读入口，不静默截断。
51	
52	完整提供之前不确认该消息已读，不凭其预览满足写入条件。`read` 续读在完整提供后确认相应消息；`message` 续读保持查询性质，之后可由 `read` 确认并省略重复正文。一次调用必须前进或明确指向可用的续读动作，不能反复返回同一开头。
53	
54	返回范围与确认范围必须来自同一次选择。不能先确认整批，再在 renderer 末尾裁掉正文。旧的“最多若干条”不能冒充总文本长度预算。具体预算在实现时按现有约定和样例测定，不新增用户配置。
55	
56	### 4.2 已提供内容的确认
57	
58	`read` 是唯一显式确认入口，不新增独立“标记已读”工具。确认当前上下文中完整可见的事实时可以不重复正文；新到的或已不完整可见的内容照常提供。无需每次回复后立刻补调用，可在处理 Inbox 时合并确认。
59	
60	## 5. 写入条件与错误恢复
61	
62	对 Thread、Main 和 Task/Claim 使用一致的“所需事实是否完整提供”原则，但不统一它们本来不同的权限或 revision 要求。Main 不因本工作项新增 Thread 写入凭据。
63	
64	可以满足相应阅读条件的内容：来源和对象明确的完整通知、`read/history/message` 结果、拒绝结果中的完整变化，以及具有必要字段的 Task/Claim 事件。只检查本次操作适用的必要事实，不要求读完全部历史。
65	
66	不能据以判定完整提供：数量、标题、摘要、截断正文、模型自己的总结或“我看过了”。看板上的当前状态只证明当前状态，不代表相关事件或讨论已提供。
67	
68	- 拒绝结果完整补齐必要事实后，允许 Agent 重新考虑并提交，不强制重复读取相同内容。
69	- 结果未补齐时，明确缺失与读取入口，不提供暗示可直接写的凭据或恢复句。
70	- 凭据不保证成功。提交时仍检查最新未读、权限、Thread revision 和 Task 状态。
71	- 仅满足写入条件不写持久已读、不消费未读标记。
72	- 不保留正文子串匹配作为备用判断。必须对应具体事实及实际可见内容，短消息不能因别处出现 `ok` 而误命中。
73	
74	## 6. 通知
75	
76	| 类型 | 默认内容 |
77	| --- | --- |
78	| 直接提及或回复通知 | 发送者、原文、所属讨论、消息定位、必要回复背景 |
79	| 普通更新 | Thread/Main 入口及未读数量，不复制正文 |
80	| Task/Claim 变化 | 操作者、对象、实际变化、变化后状态和与读者的关系；不猜原因 |
81	| ownership 变化 | 新增或撤销的责任，不顺带重发全部背景 |
82	| DM | 发送者和原文；不虚构 Thread、不计入 Inbox |
83	
84	同批合并；直接提及和责任变化优先于普通计数。重要内容被省略时明确说明还有直接信号未展开，并给入口。既有已通知正文不得反复挤占新变化；重启/恢复保留既有可重派生投递语义，不新增投递数据库。
85	
86	通知预算约束整体输出，包含外层说明和读取入口。正文截断与其完整性判断一致。已提供必要事实时，不统一追加“必须先 read”；是否需要读取按当前缺失决定。通知不确认已读。
87	
88	通知派发性能由并行工作项负责；本工作项不另写派发器。实施通知票前核实那条线的最新实现，避免覆盖其改动。
89	
90	## 7. 工具结果与规则放置
91	
92	### 7.1 操作结果
93	
94	明确区分：已提交、未提交、已记录但未送达，以及确实无法确认的提交结果。
95	
96	- 成功给本次变化、必要对象标识和后续凭据，不重放全部正文或规则；没有必要下一步时不硬加建议。
97	- 部分投递失败不冒充操作未提交，不诱导重发已写入的内容。
98	- 拒绝说明原因及当前可执行恢复；需要重新判断时不说“原样重试”。
99	- 只有实际证据不足以判定提交结果时才说“不确定”；不用通用 catch 把所有错误改成不确定，也不为此前未遇到的错误增加完整重试框架。
100	
101	### 7.2 七工具职责
102	
103	`team_view` 提供地址目录，`team_inbox` 提供未读入口，`team_attention` 管关注，`team_thread` 提供读取和显式已读确认，`team_message` 管公开发言，`team_dm` 管直接投递，`team_task` 管工作状态。目录、看板和关注结果不扩张成正文读取或第二套写入依据。
104	
105	### 7.3 规则
106	
107	规则统一定义，但允许使用位置的必要短提醒：persona 放跨工具规则，工具说明放选择及调用所需契约，参数说明保留必要格式，结果说明本次状态和恢复，core skill 放详细方法和少见情况。不得为了去重让基本调用先依赖读教程。
108	
109	## 8. 工程落点
110	
111	Host module 保有事实、权限、阅读提交与写入检查的 interface；tool module 负责参数、Agent 结果和文本。Client 不解析这些文本。共享的内部 module 只承担当前真实重复的完整性判断或渲染，不建通用 Agent-facing 语义框架。
112	
113	实施依据和 Harness interface 核对见 [工程核对](materials/2026-10-29-implementation-notes.md)。尤其注意：canonical 工具结果不自动持久化；当前 surface 中的最终文本才参与判断；裁剪后 `meta` 可能原样留下，不能只信 `meta`。复用 Session 记录，不建独立的已读事实库。
114	
115	读取批次与确认需要在 Host 中协调。必要时增加窄的 Agent-owned 读取 interface，复用既有 Host 提交；不让 Session 可见性成为 ledger 重放的输入，不从 Agent renderer 更改 Human 读取行为。既有持久记录保持可重放，不为文案优化改变旧 operation 的解释。
116	
117	现有公开 seam 不足时先记录具体限制再决定；不访问私有字段、不修改 Harness、不虚构已经存在的承诺。结构选择、字段、预算和内部测试由实施者决定，无需逐项交 Human 拍板。
118	
119	## 9. 完整流程与验收
120	
121	[六段完整流程](materials/2026-10-29-accepted-flows.md)是行为验收入口，不是仅比较措辞的 snapshot。
122	
123	1. 起步、记忆更新、责任变化、压缩后恢复。
124	2. 普通更新、读取、理解当前分工、领取工作。
125	3. 直接提及、无需重复正文即可回复、稍后显式确认已读。
126	4. 旧状态写入被拒、收到完整变化、修改行动后提交。
127	5. 压缩后进入旧讨论、无未读也能恢复背景。
128	6. 长消息分段、可继续读取、完整后按动作性质确认。
129	
130	实现检查使用真实累计的 Session surface；覆盖裁剪、压缩、重启、短正文、跨 Thread 同文、旧凭据、新消息并发、memory 异常及通知上限。只覆盖现实生命周期与公开输入，不为类型已保证的内部值叠防御测试。
131	
132	模型评测复用既有 harness，使用隔离的合成场景，不上传个人会话语料；接入模型前核实本轮可用且获授权的配置，不复用归档中的凭据。关键指标是目标完成、根据新事实改行动、误调用与恢复次数，其后才是上下文 token/字符、总调用数与耗时。比较同一版本窗口和场景，重复运行并报告样本及波动，不承诺未测的成本比例。
133	
134	## 10. 实施与完成条件
135	
136	当前可开始的实施票为 01、02；其后按 [README 的依赖顺序](README.md#实施顺序)推进。每票包含行为、可见输出、测试及受影响正式文档，不先搭横向框架再等最后集成。
137	
138	完成要求：六段流程成立；关键新事实不丢失；无无效凭据指引、错误确认或重复读取循环；模型评测不出现未解释的正确性回退；相关旧路径与矛盾规则删除；双语正式文档和 CHANGELOG 同步；仅在影响 assembled Web/Remote 等面时运行相应浏览器检查。
139	
140	本次批准的是设计整理，不是生产实现、模型付费调用、提交或发布授权。设计检查通过不等于上述实现验收通过。

1	# Start and checks
2	
3	English | [中文](start-and-checks.zh.md)
4	
5	## Scope
6	This document records maintenance workflows for the repository. Exact command definitions remain authoritative in the root `package.json`, package manifests, and `scripts/`; update configuration first when a command changes, then update this document.
7	
8	## Start developing
9	This repository is an independent external DSH bundle. End users install the published package; local development and real Web verification require the adjacent `../deepseek-harness` checkout.
10	
11	```text
12	../
13	├── deepseek-harness/
14	└── dsh-agent-team/
15	```
16	
17	Install dependencies with the command specified by the root README:
18	
19	```sh
20	corepack pnpm install
21	```
22	
23	`pnpm-workspace.yaml` does not declare `packages/*` as workspace members: the repository publishes one root npm package and its three `packages/*` directories are build targets of that one workspace, not independently installable packages. The file is still load-bearing — it disables automatic peer installation and carries the build-approval and release-age settings this repository relies on — so do not change or remove it because a directory lacks its own manifest. The root `node_modules` and adjacent Harness checkout provide the packages and source mappings needed for local development.
24	
25	## Verification gradient
26	Run the smallest sufficient checks for the change:
27	
28	```sh
29	npm run generate:typert
30	npm run typecheck
31	npm run check:docs
32	npm run check:core-skills
33	npm run check:boundaries
34	npm run check:versions
35	npm run check:facades
36	npm test
37	npm run build
38	npm run lint
39	npm run duplication
40	npm pack --dry-run
41	npm run check:artifact
42	npm run check:public-baseline
43	git diff --check HEAD
44	```
45	
46	Their responsibilities are:
47	
48	- `generate:typert` emits Typert Host/Remote artifacts from the Host face in `packages/agent-team/src/`.
49	- `typecheck` regenerates Typert and checks Host, tools, and Client sources.
50	- `check:docs` mechanically enforces the rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md): bilingual pairing with a working switcher, a shared heading outline per pair (the same headings at the same levels), relative links, `#fragment` heading anchors, the per-file longest-block ceiling recorded in the script, and both indexes naming exactly the documents that exist. It covers the four README pairs as well — the repository root and one per package — plus the root contributing pair, each set with its own switcher wording. Run it on its own for a documentation-only change.
51	  - `node scripts/check-docs.mjs --budgets` prints the per-file longest-block table instead of deciding.
52	- `check:core-skills` mechanically enforces the shipped skill contract under `packages/agent-team/core-skills/`: the front matter names the skill after its directory and its description names real triggers, the whole skill stays inside the reviewed budget in `scripts/check-core-skills.mjs`, every relative link stays inside the skill directory (an installer copies that directory alone), and every file under `references/` is linked from `SKILL.md`.
53	- `check:boundaries` mechanically enforces the package seams described below: no file under `packages/*/src/` may reach another package by a relative specifier that escapes its own package directory. `import type` is exempt because it is erased before runtime, and test files are out of scope because they deliberately wire directories together. Declared subpaths such as `@contexera/dsh-agent-team/remote` are the supported way to cross a seam.
54	- `check:versions` mechanically enforces the certified-version consistency rule: the CI tag, the setup tag, the development guide, the READMEs, the architecture doc, the compatibility baseline, and the bug-report placeholder must all state the same DSH baseline (in both languages). That baseline must also be the lower bound of every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer range. It asserts mutual agreement, never a hardcoded version, so it passes unchanged on every release lane. Run it on its own after touching any version string.
55	- `check:comments` mechanically enforces two comment rules over `packages/*/src` and `scripts/`, excluding `vendor/`. First, a per-scope comment-line budget recorded in the script (see its header). Second, a comment may not cite `.scratch/`, a work-item number, or an acceptance criterion: none of those resolve for a reader of the published package, and work history is not an authority. A bare `issue #<n>` is fine — it resolves to a real GitHub issue — and so is `Task #<n>`, a documented Team entity.
56	- `check:facades` writes nothing: it recomputes the path facades from the adjacent Harness checkout and refuses a committed `tsconfig*.json` or `.generated-harness` marker that differs from the generated output, so a subpath added to `scripts/sync-paths.mjs` cannot land without its regenerated facades. `npm test` runs it, which is why a fresh clone regenerates the facades first (see [`environments-and-install.md`](./environments-and-install.md)).
57	- `test` regenerates Typert, runs `check:facades`, `check:docs`, `check:core-skills`, `check:boundaries`, `check:versions`, and `check:comments`, then runs Vitest. `scripts/isolate-dsh-home.setup.ts` gives each test file an isolated `DSH_HOME`; tests needing a particular home must save and restore it. Startup does not prune ledger-unknown Member directories; explicit Member removal removes that Member's private memory.
58	- The suite pins one time zone (`Asia/Shanghai`, in `vitest.config.ts`), because time rendering is zone-dependent by contract: a seat states the reader's own clock, so the same expectation otherwise reads as a different hour on every runner — UTC in CI, UTC+8 where this is maintained. The pinned zone is deliberately not UTC, which keeps the assertion sharp: a formatter that reaches for `getUTCHours` renders an hour that is not the reader's and fails here. A date-sensitive test may therefore assert a literal clock time rather than read the runner's zone for its expectation.
59	- The Client bench (`packages/client-agent-team/tests/harness.tsx`) fails a spec whose rendered shipped slot entry crashed: the shipped error boundary contains the throw and reports it only through `console.error`, so an unguarded run stays green while the surface is gone. That bench also supplies what jsdom lacks (`ResizeObserver`, `document.fonts`) and the whole `conversation` service face — an absent observable member is not a missing method but a `WeakMap.set(undefined)` throw in the renderer's hook cache.
60	- `build` uses the restricted Node cleaner to clear package `lib/` directories, regenerates Typert, builds all three source trees, and uses Harness `tsdown` for the Client bundle. The published artifact remains one root npm package.
61	- `lint` runs oxlint.
62	- `duplication` runs jscpd over `packages` and `scripts` using `.jscpd.json`; treat its output as a place to look, never as a verdict, because it reports moved and restructured code as readily as copied code.
63	- `pack --dry-run` checks the root bundle's published contents; `prepack` runs the full build first, so it is a release prerequisite rather than an everyday check.
64	- `check:artifact` reads back what `npm pack` would actually ship and refuses an artifact that would ship broken: stray `.ts`/`.tsx` sources, a missing `cordis.patch.yml`, or a runtime relative import whose target is not inside the tarball. That last one is invisible to every local check, because the working tree has every file. Run it after `build` and before publishing.
65	- `check:public-baseline` compares the certified DSH baseline declared by the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peers against every public surface that restates it by hand — both READMEs and the pinned compatibility discussion in the Harness repository. A surface it cannot parse is a failure, never a skip, so rewording a README cannot quietly drop it out of coverage. It needs `gh`; `--offline` skips the discussion read and is for local iteration only.
66	
67	Both gates are publish-time checks rather than everyday ones; [`release-runbook.md`](../release-runbook.md) places them in the order a release runs them.
68	
69	Changes affecting browser bundles, Client modules, slots, Remote activation, bundle manifests, or visible UI must also run:
70	
71	```sh
72	npm run test:browser
73	```
74	
75	Visible UI changes touching Team controls or surfaces additionally run the mechanical design-language audit (shipped-reference tripwires included):
76	
77	```sh
78	node scripts/audit-ui-parity.mjs
79	```
80	
81	The audit compares Team Client CSS/TSX against the design-language contract in `docs/frontend-design/principles-and-language.md`: focus visibility, control rhythm, icon semantics, hardcoded colors, and shipped-reference presence. Run it after any visible-UI change and after every DSH upgrade.
82	
83	This builds first, copies built packages into a temporary profile, starts the official Harness Web scaffold, and runs the real journey with `/usr/bin/google-chrome` (override with `CHROME_PATH`). The sandbox setup provisions Playwright's own chromium at that path when the base image ships no browser. It cleans the temporary profile and Harness test files afterward.
84	
85	There are three explicit preview/verification paths:
86	
87	```sh
88	npm run preview:ui                         # keyless Team fixture
89	npm run test:browser                       # repeatable keyless browser acceptance
90	DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=... npm run preview       # real model interaction
91	```
92	
93	`preview` and `preview:ui` use temporary profiles and storage and clean up on `Ctrl+C`. `preview` always uses the real DeepSeek adapter and fails when credentials are missing; it does not silently switch to replay. `preview:ui` uses a keyless route-only adapter whose fixture does not call a model; an accidental model request fails explicitly.
94	
95	All three lanes stage this bundle and its declared dependency closure into a temporary profile, then name that staged copy as a profile package — the shape `dsh plugin add` leaves behind: a `file:` dependency, a link under the profile's own `node_modules`, and an entry in `dsh.profile.bundles`. The scaffold resolves plugin imports from a computed generation built out of `profile.layers`, so only a staged copy named there contributes the Team rows, and they come from the bundle's own `cordis.patch.yml`.
96	
97	A command-line overlay is not an equivalent mount. The Host row's Human-profile form is written to the profile document, and the config editor rejects that write while a later layer (a home patch or a command-line overlay) declares the same row — `overridden by a home patch or command-line overlay` — so the form stays unwritable. A staged bundle the scaffold never names resolves neither its own rows nor its dependency closure: every Team row reports `failed to import` with no module-resolution error to read, and the keyless fixture then fails on an `undefined` `ctx.agentTeam`.
98	
99	`test:browser` does not cover the two preview lanes, so boot them by hand after any change to scaffold composition or profile resolution.
100	
101	The browser journey uses a deterministic keyless Host/Client driver. It covers Agent Inbox reading/replying, Human Project and Thread navigation, persistence after reload, and restoration of the ordinary DSH surface after leaving Team mode.
102

Base directory for this skill: /home/yu/.claude/skills/tdd

# Test-Driven Development

TDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.

When exploring the codebase, read the repo's terminology home (a `GLOSSARY.md`, `CONTEXT.md`, or `docs/domain-model.md` — whatever it keeps, if it keeps one) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.

## What a good test is

Tests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: "user can checkout with valid cart" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.

See [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.

## Seams: where tests go

A **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.

**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.

Ask: "What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.

When the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with "codebase-design" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.

## Anti-patterns

- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.
- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.
- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.

## Rules of the loop

- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.
- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.
- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.

5	Team is one collaboration domain per DSH home. Its append-only operation ledger is durable authority for Member, Workspace, Project, Message, independent Thread aggregates, optional Task overlays, Claim, Thread Attention, Inbox, and Activity facts.

7	When changing a Host capability, read package source/tests first and then the matching Harness contract. [`harness-navigation.md`](../harness-navigation.md) maps the route to `deepseek-harness/docs/subsystems/` and source packages.
